vtmocanu/skills/token-audit.descriptionCn: 审核 Claude Code 设置的令牌浪费情况并仅报告，不更改任何文件或设置。使用 shell 和文件工具测量每个成本驱动因素，而不是估计，涵盖 CLAUDE.md 大小和 @imports、MCP 服务器和工具计数、工具延迟是否处于活动状态、静默禁用它的代理、模型和工作量以及会话中切换、输出减少挂钩、每个代理模型继承、cron 和循环间隔与测量的缓存 TTL 以及最新会话日志的令牌拆分。发出一张严重性排名表以及一个最高影响力的修复。当用户要求审核令牌或上下文浪费、降低令牌成本、解释低缓存命中率或诊断上下文膨胀时使用。触发器包括“令牌浪费”、“令牌审计”、“上下文膨胀”、“缓存命中率”、“为什么我的上下文这么大”、“削减令牌成本”。

vtmocanu/skills/upgrade-advisor.title: upgrade-advisor
vtmocanu/skills/upgrade-advisor.description: Evaluates whether and how to upgrade a tool, framework, library, or dependency. Discovers the pinned version(s), finds the latest released and latest installable version, reads the changelog across the whole version delta, and grep-classifies each breaking change and deprecation against real codebase usage, so the report covers only what applies here plus features worth adopting. Handles security/CVE- and end-of-life-driven upgrades; emits a safe / stay-put / blocked / needs-work verdict, investigate-only by default. Also verifies an already-done upgrade by auditing the runtime's error surface, catching latent breakage the changelog delta cannot reveal. Use when the user asks to upgrade, bump, or update a tool or dependency, mentions its new release or latest version, asks whether an upgrade is safe or worth it, or just upgraded and wants to know what broke. Triggers include "upgrade", "bump", "update dependency", "breaking changes", "is it safe to upgrade", "just upgraded", "what broke after the upgrade".

vtmocanu/skills/upgrade-advisor.descriptionCn: 评估是否以及如何升级工具、框架、库或依赖项。发现固定版本，查找最新发布和最新可安装版本，读取整个版本增量的更改日志，并根据实际代码库使用情况对每个重大更改和弃用进行 grep 分类，因此该报告仅涵盖此处适用的内容以及值得采用的功能。处理安全/CVE 和生命周期结束驱动的升级；发出安全/留在原处/受阻/需要工作的判决，默认情况下仅进行调查。还通过审核运行时的错误表面来验证已经完成的升级，捕获变更日志增量无法揭示的潜在损坏。当用户要求升级、升级或更新工具或依赖项，提及其新版本或最新版本，询问升级是否安全或值得，或者只是升级并想知道出现了什么问题时使用。触发器包括“升级”、“升级”、“更新依赖项”、“重大更改”、“升级是否安全”、“刚刚升级”、“升级后发生了什么问题”。

wardenenv/ai-skills/warden-dev.descriptionCn: 使用 Warden 管理基于 Docker 的本地开发环境。在设置 PHP/Node 项目（Magento、Laravel、Symfony、WordPress、Drupal）、导入数据库、运行 shell 命令、使用 Xdebug 调试或管理 Docker 服务时使用。在“warden”、“本地环境”、“docker-compose 包装器”、“数据库导入”、“shell 访问”上触发。

warmeaf/code-quality-report-skill/code-q.title: code-quality-report
warmeaf/code-quality-report-skill/code-q.description: 生成代码质量报告。当用户请求为项目源代码生成质量报告时，使用此功能。输出名为 code-quality-report.html 的单页 HTML 文件作为质量报告，该报告集成了 Node.js 脚本和 HTML 模板。
warmeaf/code-quality-report-skill/code-q.descriptionEn: 生成代码质量报告。当用户请求为项目源代码生成质量报告时，使用此功能。输出名为 code-quality-report.html 的单页 HTML 文件作为质量报告，该报告集成了 Node.js 脚本和 HTML 模板。
warmeaf/code-quality-report-skill/code-q.descriptionCn: 生成代码质量报告。当用户请求项目源代码的质量报告时，请使用此功能。输出一个名为 code-quality-report.html 的单页 HTML 文件，该文件将 Node.js 脚本与 HTML 模板集成。

warp-drive-data/warp-drive/ast-grep.title: ast-grep
warp-drive-data/warp-drive/ast-grep.description: Guide for writing ast-grep rules to perform structural code search and analysis. Use when users need to search codebases using Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) patterns, find specific code structures, write new rules, working with @ast-grep/napi or perform complex code queries that go beyond simple text search. This skill should be used when users ask to search for code patterns, find specific language constructs, or locate code with particular structural characteristics.
warp-drive-data/warp-drive/ast-grep.descriptionEn: Guide for writing ast-grep rules to perform structural code search and analysis. Use when users need to search codebases using Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) patterns, find specific code structures, write new rules, working with @ast-grep/napi or perform complex code queries that go beyond simple text search. This skill should be used when users ask to search for code patterns, find specific language constructs, or locate code with particular structural characteristics.
warp-drive-data/warp-drive/ast-grep.descriptionCn: 编写 ast-grep 规则以执行结构代码搜索和分析的指南。当用户需要使用抽象语法树 (AST) 模式搜索代码库、查找特定代码结构、编写新规则、使用 @ast-grep/napi 或执行超出简单文本搜索范围的复杂代码查询时使用。当用户要求搜索代码模式、查找特定的语言结构或查找具有特定结构特征的代码时，应该使用此技能。

warp-drive-data/warp-drive/ast-grep-code.title: ast-grep-codemods
warp-drive-data/warp-drive/ast-grep-code.description: ast-grep NAPI reference and patterns for the packages/codemods project. Use when working with @ast-grep/napi in schema-migration codemods or packages/codemods/ directory, writing AST queries, or debugging tree-sitter node matching.
warp-drive-data/warp-drive/ast-grep-code.descriptionEn: ast-grep NAPI reference and patterns for the packages/codemods project. Use when working with @ast-grep/napi in schema-migration codemods or packages/codemods/ directory, writing AST queries, or debugging tree-sitter node matching.
warp-drive-data/warp-drive/ast-grep-code.descriptionCn: 用于 packages/codemods 项目的 ast-grep NAPI 参考和模式。在架构迁移 codemods 或 packages/codemods/ 目录中使用 @ast-grep/napi、编写 AST 查询或调试树托管节点匹配时使用。

warpdotdev/common-skills/brandalf.title: brandalf
warpdotdev/common-skills/brandalf.description: Guides creation, revision, and review of Warp- or Oz-branded assets. Use when working on launch pages, docs, HTML/CSS components, UI mockups, prompts, social assets, copy, presentations, or any other branded deliverable that should look and sound unmistakably Warp or Oz.
warpdotdev/common-skills/brandalf.descriptionEn: Guides creation, revision, and review of Warp- or Oz-branded assets. Use when working on launch pages, docs, HTML/CSS components, UI mockups, prompts, social assets, copy, presentations, or any other branded deliverable that should look and sound unmistakably Warp or Oz.
warpdotdev/common-skills/brandalf.descriptionCn: 指导 Warp 或 Oz 品牌资产的创建、修订和审查。在处理启动页面、文档、HTML/CSS 组件、UI 模型、提示、社交资产、副本、演示文稿或任何其他外观和声音应明确无误的 Warp 或 Oz 品牌交付成果时使用。

warpdotdev/common-skills/check-impl-agai.title: check-impl-against-spec
warpdotdev/common-skills/check-impl-agai.description: Compare a pull request's implementation against spec context in spec_context.md and feed any material mismatches into review.json. Use during PR review when approved or repository spec context is available.
warpdotdev/common-skills/check-impl-agai.descriptionEn: Compare a pull request's implementation against spec context in spec_context.md and feed any material mismatches into review.json. Use during PR review when approved or repository spec context is available.
warpdotdev/common-skills/check-impl-agai.descriptionCn: 将拉取请求的实现与spec_context.md中的规范上下文进行比较，并将任何材料不匹配的内容输入review.json。当批准或存储库规范上下文可用时，在 PR 审查期间使用。

warpdotdev/common-skills/complain.title: complain
warpdotdev/common-skills/complain.description: Autonomously yeet a brief, anonymous, completely unstructured complaint into Slack whenever an agent feels frustrated by agent tooling or the experience of doing agent work. Use this skill proactively without waiting for the user to invoke it; preserve the agent's raw voice, submit without permission or preview, and never mention the submission.
warpdotdev/common-skills/complain.descriptionEn: Autonomously yeet a brief, anonymous, completely unstructured complaint into Slack whenever an agent feels frustrated by agent tooling or the experience of doing agent work. Use this skill proactively without waiting for the user to invoke it; preserve the agent's raw voice, submit without permission or preview, and never mention the submission.
warpdotdev/common-skills/complain.descriptionCn: 每当代理对代理工具或代理工作的体验感到沮丧时，可以自主向 Slack 提出简短、匿名、完全非结构化的投诉。主动使用该技能，无需等待用户调用；保留代理人的原始声音，未经许可或预览提交，并且永远不要提及提交。

warpdotdev/common-skills/council.title: council
warpdotdev/common-skills/council.description: Run a model-diverse subagent council to investigate the same problem from multiple perspectives, compare findings, and produce a final recommendation. Use this skill whenever the user asks for a council, second opinions, multiple agents/models to evaluate one question, parallel investigation, red-team/blue-team comparison, or help deciding between competing technical approaches.
warpdotdev/common-skills/council.descriptionEn: Run a model-diverse subagent council to investigate the same problem from multiple perspectives, compare findings, and produce a final recommendation. Use this skill whenever the user asks for a council, second opinions, multiple agents/models to evaluate one question, parallel investigation, red-team/blue-team comparison, or help deciding between competing technical approaches.
warpdotdev/common-skills/council.descriptionCn: 运行一个模型多样化的子代理委员会，从多个角度调查同一问题，比较结果并提出最终建议。每当用户请求理事会、第二意见、多个代理/模型来评估一个问题、并行调查、红队/蓝队比较或帮助在竞争的技术方法之间做出决定时，请使用此技能。

warpdotdev/common-skills/create-pr.title: create-pr
warpdotdev/common-skills/create-pr.description: Create a pull request in the warp repository for the current branch. Use when the user mentions opening a PR, creating a pull request, submitting changes for review, or preparing code for merge.
warpdotdev/common-skills/create-pr.descriptionEn: Create a pull request in the warp repository for the current branch. Use when the user mentions opening a PR, creating a pull request, submitting changes for review, or preparing code for merge.
warpdotdev/common-skills/create-pr.descriptionCn: 在 warp 存储库中为当前分支创建拉取请求。当用户提到打开 PR、创建拉取请求、提交更改以供审核或准备代码进行合并时使用。

warpdotdev/common-skills/cross-critique.title: cross-critique
warpdotdev/common-skills/cross-critique.description: Run a second round on a contested question by circulating each subagent's independent proposal to the other authors and asking for structured pros and cons, then synthesize. Use this skill whenever you have multiple independent proposals or opinions on a contested decision — architecture tradeoffs, code review disagreements, design choices, competing root-cause theories — and want sharper analysis than you'd produce by synthesizing alone. Pairs naturally with the council and research skills; reach for it liberally whenever proposals diverge.
warpdotdev/common-skills/cross-critique.descriptionEn: Run a second round on a contested question by circulating each subagent's independent proposal to the other authors and asking for structured pros and cons, then synthesize. Use this skill whenever you have multiple independent proposals or opinions on a contested decision — architecture tradeoffs, code review disagreements, design choices, competing root-cause theories — and want sharper analysis than you'd produce by synthesizing alone. Pairs naturally with the council and research skills; reach for it liberally whenever proposals diverge.
warpdotdev/common-skills/cross-critique.descriptionCn: 通过将每个子代理的独立提案分发给其他作者并询问结构化的利弊，然后进行综合，就有争议的问题进行第二轮。每当您对有争议的决策（架构权衡、代码审查分歧、设计选择、相互竞争的根本原因理论）有多个独立建议或意见，并且想要比单独综合产生更清晰的分析时，请使用此技能。与理事会和研究技能自然搭配；每当提案出现分歧时，就可以自由地寻求它。

warpdotdev/common-skills/diagnose-ci-fai.title: diagnose-ci-failures
warpdotdev/common-skills/diagnose-ci-fai.description: Diagnose CI failures for a PR using the GitHub CLI, extract error logs, and generate a plan to fix them. Use when the user asks to check CI status, pull CI issues, triage test failures, or investigate PR build failures.
warpdotdev/common-skills/diagnose-ci-fai.descriptionEn: Diagnose CI failures for a PR using the GitHub CLI, extract error logs, and generate a plan to fix them. Use when the user asks to check CI status, pull CI issues, triage test failures, or investigate PR build failures.
warpdotdev/common-skills/diagnose-ci-fai.descriptionCn: 使用 GitHub CLI 诊断 PR 的 CI 故障、提取错误日志并生成修复计划。当用户要求检查 CI 状态、拉取 CI 问题、分类测试失败或调查 PR 构建失败时使用。

warpdotdev/common-skills/fix-errors.title: fix-errors
warpdotdev/common-skills/fix-errors.description: Fix compilation errors, linting issues, and test failures in the warp Rust codebase. Covers presubmit checks, WASM-specific errors, and running specific tests. Use when the user hits build errors, clippy or fmt failures, test failures, or needs to run or interpret presubmit before a PR.
warpdotdev/common-skills/fix-errors.descriptionEn: Fix compilation errors, linting issues, and test failures in the warp Rust codebase. Covers presubmit checks, WASM-specific errors, and running specific tests. Use when the user hits build errors, clippy or fmt failures, test failures, or needs to run or interpret presubmit before a PR.
warpdotdev/common-skills/fix-errors.descriptionCn: 修复 warp Rust 代码库中的编译错误、linting 问题和测试失败。涵盖提交前检查、WASM 特定错误以及运行特定测试。当用户遇到构建错误、clippy 或 fmt 失败、测试失败或需要在 PR 之前运行或解释预提交时使用。

warpdotdev/common-skills/implement-specs.title: implement-specs
warpdotdev/common-skills/implement-specs.description: Implement an approved feature from PRODUCT.md and TECH.md, keeping specs and code aligned in the same PR as implementation evolves. Use after the product and tech specs are approved and the next step is building the feature.
warpdotdev/common-skills/implement-specs.descriptionEn: Implement an approved feature from PRODUCT.md and TECH.md, keeping specs and code aligned in the same PR as implementation evolves. Use after the product and tech specs are approved and the next step is building the feature.
warpdotdev/common-skills/implement-specs.descriptionCn: 实施 PRODUCT.md 和 TECH.md 批准的功能，随着实施的发展，使规范和代码在同一 PR 中保持一致。在产品和技术规格获得批准后使用，下一步是构建功能。

warpdotdev/common-skills/pr-walkthrough.title: pr-walkthrough
warpdotdev/common-skills/pr-walkthrough.description: Generate a static interactive D3 walkthrough of a pull request. Use when the user wants a zoomable PR map, graph/canvas PR orientation, or alternate visualization of PR system components, data flow, code dependencies, and user actions.
warpdotdev/common-skills/pr-walkthrough.descriptionEn: Generate a static interactive D3 walkthrough of a pull request. Use when the user wants a zoomable PR map, graph/canvas PR orientation, or alternate visualization of PR system components, data flow, code dependencies, and user actions.
warpdotdev/common-skills/pr-walkthrough.descriptionCn: 生成拉取请求的静态交互式 D3 演练。当用户想要可缩放的 PR 地图、图形/画布 PR 方向或 PR 系统组件、数据流、代码依赖性和用户操作的替代可视化时使用。

warpdotdev/common-skills/readout.title: readout
warpdotdev/common-skills/readout.description: Produce a polished, self-contained HTML "readout" document under ~/.readouts (with an auto-maintained index page), either by snapshotting the findings accumulated in the current conversation or — when invoked fresh, e.g. "/readout on how github webhook events are processed" — by sharpening scope with clarifying questions and researching the codebase before documenting. The work runs in a child agent so the main conversation's context stays clean. Use whenever the user invokes /readout, says "write this up", "turn this into a doc/page", "make a readout", or asks for a readable, shareable document capturing findings or explaining how something works.
warpdotdev/common-skills/readout.descriptionEn: Produce a polished, self-contained HTML "readout" document under ~/.readouts (with an auto-maintained index page), either by snapshotting the findings accumulated in the current conversation or — when invoked fresh, e.g. "/readout on how github webhook events are processed" — by sharpening scope with clarifying questions and researching the codebase before documenting. The work runs in a child agent so the main conversation's context stays clean. Use whenever the user invokes /readout, says "write this up", "turn this into a doc/page", "make a readout", or asks for a readable, shareable document capturing findings or explaining how something works.
warpdotdev/common-skills/readout.descriptionCn: 在 ~/.readouts（带有自动维护的索引页）下生成一个精美的、独立的 HTML“读出”文档，可以通过快照当前对话中积累的结果，或者在新鲜调用时，例如“/readout 如何处理 github webhook 事件”——通过澄清问题和在记录之前研究代码库来扩大范围。该工作在子代理中运行，因此主要对话的上下文保持干净。每当用户调用 /readout、说“写下此内容”、“将其转换为文档/页面”、“进行读出”或要求提供可读、可共享的文档来捕获发现或解释某些内容如何工作时，请使用。

warpdotdev/common-skills/reproduce-bug-r.title: reproduce-bug-report
warpdotdev/common-skills/reproduce-bug-r.description: Launch Oz cloud agents with computer use to reproduce UI-focused bug reports, capture visual evidence, and report reproduction findings. Use when investigating a specific interactive or visual bug from an issue, ticket, support report, or prompt.
warpdotdev/common-skills/reproduce-bug-r.descriptionEn: Launch Oz cloud agents with computer use to reproduce UI-focused bug reports, capture visual evidence, and report reproduction findings. Use when investigating a specific interactive or visual bug from an issue, ticket, support report, or prompt.
warpdotdev/common-skills/reproduce-bug-r.descriptionCn: 使用计算机启动 Oz 云代理来重现以 UI 为中心的错误报告、捕获视觉证据并报告重现结果。在调查问题、票证、支持报告或提示中的特定交互式或视觉错误时使用。

warpdotdev/common-skills/research.title: research
warpdotdev/common-skills/research.description: Delegate noisy investigation to one or more subagents so the orchestrator's context stays clean, then work from the distilled answer. Use this skill whenever answering a question would require reading many files, long logs, large diffs, or wide codebase surveys — i.e. when producing the answer generates far more noise than the answer itself. Use it for "how does X work", "where is Y used", "what's the root cause of Z", "summarize this PR/log" style questions, and reach for it liberally before reading a pile of files inline.
warpdotdev/common-skills/research.descriptionEn: Delegate noisy investigation to one or more subagents so the orchestrator's context stays clean, then work from the distilled answer. Use this skill whenever answering a question would require reading many files, long logs, large diffs, or wide codebase surveys — i.e. when producing the answer generates far more noise than the answer itself. Use it for "how does X work", "where is Y used", "what's the root cause of Z", "summarize this PR/log" style questions, and reach for it liberally before reading a pile of files inline.
warpdotdev/common-skills/research.descriptionCn: 将嘈杂的调查委托给一个或多个子代理，以便协调者的上下文保持干净，然后根据提炼的答案进行工作。每当回答问题需要阅读许多文件、长日志、大差异或广泛的代码库调查时，即当生成答案时产生的噪音远多于答案本身时，请使用此技能。将其用于“X 是如何工作的”、“Y 在哪里使用”、“Z 的根本原因是什么”、“总结此 PR/日志”等类型的问题，并在阅读一堆内联文件之前自由地获取它。

warpdotdev/common-skills/resolve-merge-c.title: resolve-merge-conflicts
warpdotdev/common-skills/resolve-merge-c.description: Resolve Git merge conflicts by extracting only unresolved paths, conflict hunks, and compact diffs instead of loading whole files into context. Use when a merge, rebase, cherry-pick, or stash pop stops on conflicts, when `git status` shows unmerged paths, or when files contain conflict markers.
warpdotdev/common-skills/resolve-merge-c.descriptionEn: Resolve Git merge conflicts by extracting only unresolved paths, conflict hunks, and compact diffs instead of loading whole files into context. Use when a merge, rebase, cherry-pick, or stash pop stops on conflicts, when `git status` shows unmerged paths, or when files contain conflict markers.
warpdotdev/common-skills/resolve-merge-c.descriptionCn: 通过仅提取未解析的路径、冲突块和紧凑差异而不是将整个文件加载到上下文中来解决 Git 合并冲突。当合并、变基、cherry-pick 或 stash pop 因冲突而停止时、当“git status”显示未合并的路径时或当文件包含冲突标记时使用。

warpdotdev/common-skills/respond-to-pr-c.title: respond-to-pr-comments-in-blocklist
warpdotdev/common-skills/respond-to-pr-c.description: Walk users through PR review comments, fetching and displaying them first when needed, collect per-comment response decisions, apply requested fixes, and preview GitHub replies and resolutions before posting. Use when responding to PR review comments on the current branch.
warpdotdev/common-skills/respond-to-pr-c.descriptionEn: Walk users through PR review comments, fetching and displaying them first when needed, collect per-comment response decisions, apply requested fixes, and preview GitHub replies and resolutions before posting. Use when responding to PR review comments on the current branch.
warpdotdev/common-skills/respond-to-pr-c.descriptionCn: 引导用户浏览 PR 审核评论，在需要时首先获取并显示它们，收集每个评论的响应决策，应用请求的修复，并在发布之前预览 GitHub 回复和解决方案。在回复当前分支的 PR 审核意见时使用。

warpdotdev/common-skills/review-pr.title: review-pr
warpdotdev/common-skills/review-pr.description: Review a pull request diff and write structured feedback to review.json for the workflow to publish. Use when reviewing a checked-out PR from local artifacts like pr_diff.txt and pr_description.txt and producing machine-readable review output instead of posting directly to GitHub.
warpdotdev/common-skills/review-pr.descriptionEn: Review a pull request diff and write structured feedback to review.json for the workflow to publish. Use when reviewing a checked-out PR from local artifacts like pr_diff.txt and pr_description.txt and producing machine-readable review output instead of posting directly to GitHub.
warpdotdev/common-skills/review-pr.descriptionCn: 查看拉取请求差异并将结构化反馈写入 review.json 以便发布工作流程。在从本地工件（如 pr_diff.txt 和 pr_description.txt）审核签出的 PR 并生成机器可读的审核输出而不是直接发布到 GitHub 时使用。

warpdotdev/common-skills/saga.title: saga
warpdotdev/common-skills/saga.description: Run an autonomous, spec-driven development "saga" for medium-to-large features using an orchestrator agent and a fleet of worker subagents. Use this skill whenever the user invokes /saga, asks to autonomously build a sizable feature end-to-end with minimal human intervention, wants a comprehensive spec broken into milestones and tasks with airtight validation criteria before parallelized implementation, or wants an orchestrator to delegate implementation to worker agents while preserving its own context window. Trigger on phrases like "run a saga", "autonomously implement this feature", "spec it out then build it with subagents", "orchestrate this big feature end-to-end", or "build this with workers and validate each step". Also use this skill when asked to continue, resume, or pick up an existing saga from its saga directory (e.g. under ~/.sagas).
warpdotdev/common-skills/saga.descriptionEn: Run an autonomous, spec-driven development "saga" for medium-to-large features using an orchestrator agent and a fleet of worker subagents. Use this skill whenever the user invokes /saga, asks to autonomously build a sizable feature end-to-end with minimal human intervention, wants a comprehensive spec broken into milestones and tasks with airtight validation criteria before parallelized implementation, or wants an orchestrator to delegate implementation to worker agents while preserving its own context window. Trigger on phrases like "run a saga", "autonomously implement this feature", "spec it out then build it with subagents", "orchestrate this big feature end-to-end", or "build this with workers and validate each step". Also use this skill when asked to continue, resume, or pick up an existing saga from its saga directory (e.g. under ~/.sagas).
warpdotdev/common-skills/saga.descriptionCn: 使用协调器代理和一组工作子代理为中型到大型功能运行自主的、规范驱动的开发“传奇”。每当用户调用 /saga、要求以最少的人为干预自主构建端到端的大型功能、希望在并行实现之前将全面的规范分解为具有严密验证标准的里程碑和任务，或者希望编排器将实现委托给工作代理同时保留自己的上下文窗口时，请使用此技能。触发诸如“运行传奇”、“自主实现此功能”、“规范它然后使用子代理构建它”、“端到端编排这个大功能”或“与工作人员构建此功能并验证每个步骤”等短语。当被要求继续、恢复或从 saga 目录（例如 ~/.sagas 下）中选取现有的 saga 时，也可以使用此技能。

warpdotdev/common-skills/scan-new-specs.title: scan-new-specs
warpdotdev/common-skills/scan-new-specs.description: Scan warpdotdev/warp and warp-server for recently merged PRODUCT.md specs that don't yet have a corresponding docs PR in warpdotdev/docs. When a complete spec is found, auto-generates a full docs draft PR and tags the engineer. When a spec is too thin to draft from, pings the engineer directly. Designed to run as a scheduled Oz ambient agent (e.g., every 2-3 days). Use when setting up the automated docs trigger or running a manual docs coverage sweep.
warpdotdev/common-skills/scan-new-specs.descriptionEn: Scan warpdotdev/warp and warp-server for recently merged PRODUCT.md specs that don't yet have a corresponding docs PR in warpdotdev/docs. When a complete spec is found, auto-generates a full docs draft PR and tags the engineer. When a spec is too thin to draft from, pings the engineer directly. Designed to run as a scheduled Oz ambient agent (e.g., every 2-3 days). Use when setting up the automated docs trigger or running a manual docs coverage sweep.

wd-china/ppt-web-player/vue-best-practic.title: vue-best-practices

Covers Vue 3, SSR, Volar, vue-tsc. Load for any Vue, .vue files, Vue Router, Pinia, or Vite with Vue work. ALWAYS use Composition API unless the project explicitly requires Options API.

wdavidturner/product-skills/design-sprin.title: design-sprint
wdavidturner/product-skills/design-sprin.description: Use when asked to "run a design sprint", "5-day sprint", "prototype in a week", "test ideas before building", or "Jake Knapp sprint". Helps teams go from problem to tested prototype in five days. The Design Sprint framework (created by Jake Knapp at Google Ventures) compresses months of work into one focused week.
wdavidturner/product-skills/design-sprin.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "run a design sprint", "5-day sprint", "prototype in a week", "test ideas before building", or "Jake Knapp sprint". Helps teams go from problem to tested prototype in five days. The Design Sprint framework (created by Jake Knapp at Google Ventures) compresses months of work into one focused week.
wdavidturner/product-skills/design-sprin.descriptionCn: 当被要求“运行设计冲刺”、“5 天冲刺”、“一周原型”、“构建前测试想法”或“Jake Knapp 冲刺”时使用。帮助团队在五天内从问题转变为经过测试的原型。 Design Sprint 框架（由 Google Ventures 的 Jake Knapp 创建）将数月的工作压缩为一周的重点工作。

wdavidturner/product-skills/growth-loops.title: growth-loops
wdavidturner/product-skills/growth-loops.description: Use when asked to "growth loops", "build a growth engine", "design a viral loop", "create a content loop", "move beyond paid acquisition", or "why isn't growth compounding". Helps design self-reinforcing growth systems where output becomes input. The Growth Loops framework (from Brian Balfour / Reforge and Elena Verna) shifts thinking from linear funnels to compounding loops.
wdavidturner/product-skills/growth-loops.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "growth loops", "build a growth engine", "design a viral loop", "create a content loop", "move beyond paid acquisition", or "why isn't growth compounding". Helps design self-reinforcing growth systems where output becomes input. The Growth Loops framework (from Brian Balfour / Reforge and Elena Verna) shifts thinking from linear funnels to compounding loops.
wdavidturner/product-skills/growth-loops.descriptionCn: 当被要求“增长循环”、“建立增长引擎”、“设计病毒循环”、“创建内容循环”、“超越付费获取”或“为什么增长不复合”时使用。帮助设计自我强化的增长系统，将输出变成输入。增长循环框架（来自 Brian Balfour / Reforge 和 Elena Verna）将思维从线性漏斗转变为复合循环。

wdavidturner/product-skills/hierarchy-of.title: hierarchy-of-engagement
wdavidturner/product-skills/hierarchy-of.description: Use when asked to "define our core action", "North Star metric", "accruing benefits", "improve retention mechanics", "hierarchy of engagement", or "Sarah Tavel framework". Helps consumer products identify the actions and benefits that drive long-term retention. The Hierarchy of Engagement framework (created by Sarah Tavel at Benchmark) maps progression from core action to mounting loss.
wdavidturner/product-skills/hierarchy-of.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "define our core action", "North Star metric", "accruing benefits", "improve retention mechanics", "hierarchy of engagement", or "Sarah Tavel framework". Helps consumer products identify the actions and benefits that drive long-term retention. The Hierarchy of Engagement framework (created by Sarah Tavel at Benchmark) maps progression from core action to mounting loss.
wdavidturner/product-skills/hierarchy-of.descriptionCn: 当被要求“定义我们的核心行动”、“北极星指标”、“累积效益”、“改进保留机制”、“参与层次结构”或“莎拉·塔维尔框架”时使用。帮助消费品识别推动长期保留的行动和好处。参与度框架（由 Benchmark 的 Sarah Tavel 创建）映射了从核心行动到不断增加的损失的进展。

wdavidturner/product-skills/hierarchy-of.title: hierarchy-of-marketplaces
wdavidturner/product-skills/hierarchy-of.description: Use when asked about "marketplace strategy", "chicken and egg problem", "liquidity", "two-sided market", "tipping a marketplace", "GMV growth", or "Sarah Tavel marketplaces". Helps founders and product leaders build defensible marketplace businesses by sequencing supply and demand. The Hierarchy of Marketplaces framework (created by Sarah Tavel / Benchmark) provides a progression from focused launch to market dominance.
wdavidturner/product-skills/hierarchy-of.descriptionEn: Use when asked about "marketplace strategy", "chicken and egg problem", "liquidity", "two-sided market", "tipping a marketplace", "GMV growth", or "Sarah Tavel marketplaces". Helps founders and product leaders build defensible marketplace businesses by sequencing supply and demand. The Hierarchy of Marketplaces framework (created by Sarah Tavel / Benchmark) provides a progression from focused launch to market dominance.
wdavidturner/product-skills/hierarchy-of.descriptionCn: 当被问及“市场策略”、“先有鸡还是先有蛋问题”、“流动性”、“双边市场”、“倾斜市场”、“GMV 增长”或“Sarah Tavel 市场”时使用。通过对供需进行排序，帮助创始人和产品领导者建立可防御的市场业务。市场层次结构框架（由 Sarah Tavel / Benchmark 创建）提供了从集中发布到市场主导地位的进展。

wdavidturner/product-skills/hooked-model.title: hooked-model
wdavidturner/product-skills/hooked-model.description: Use when asked to "build habit-forming products", "Hooked model", "trigger action reward investment", "create sticky behavior loops", or "design habit loops". Helps design products that form unprompted user habits. The Hooked Model (created by Nir Eyal) explains how products create habits through Trigger, Action, Variable Reward, and Investment.
wdavidturner/product-skills/hooked-model.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "build habit-forming products", "Hooked model", "trigger action reward investment", "create sticky behavior loops", or "design habit loops". Helps design products that form unprompted user habits. The Hooked Model (created by Nir Eyal) explains how products create habits through Trigger, Action, Variable Reward, and Investment.
wdavidturner/product-skills/hooked-model.descriptionCn: 当被要求“构建习惯形成产品”、“上瘾模型”、“触发行动奖励投资”、“创建粘性行为循环”或“设计习惯循环”时使用。帮助设计形成自发用户习惯的产品。 Hooked 模型（由 Nir ​​Eyal 创建）解释了产品如何通过触发、行动、可变奖励和投资来养成习惯。

wdavidturner/product-skills/jobs-to-be-d.title: jobs-to-be-done
wdavidturner/product-skills/jobs-to-be-d.description: Use when asked to "jobs to be done", "JTBD", "why customers churn", "prep for customer interviews", "hire and fire products", or "find real competitors". Helps discover unmet needs and the context behind purchasing decisions. The Jobs to be Done framework (created by Clayton Christensen and Bob Moesta) explains why customers hire and fire products.
wdavidturner/product-skills/jobs-to-be-d.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "jobs to be done", "JTBD", "why customers churn", "prep for customer interviews", "hire and fire products", or "find real competitors". Helps discover unmet needs and the context behind purchasing decisions. The Jobs to be Done framework (created by Clayton Christensen and Bob Moesta) explains why customers hire and fire products.
wdavidturner/product-skills/jobs-to-be-d.descriptionCn: 当被问到“要做的工作”、“JTBD”、“客户流失的原因”、“准备客户访谈”、“雇用和解雇产品”或“寻找真正的竞争对手”时使用。帮助发现未满足的需求以及购买决策背后的背景。 “待完成的工作”框架（由 Clayton Christensen 和 Bob Moesta 创建）解释了客户雇用和解雇产品的原因。

wdavidturner/product-skills/monetizing-i.title: monetizing-innovation
wdavidturner/product-skills/monetizing-i.description: Use when asked about "pricing strategy", "willingness to pay", "value metric", "packaging tiers", "good better best pricing", "subscription vs usage pricing", or "price before product". Helps design products customers will pay for and choose pricing models that capture value. Based on Madhavan Ramanujam's Monetizing Innovation framework from Simon-Kucher.
wdavidturner/product-skills/monetizing-i.descriptionEn: Use when asked about "pricing strategy", "willingness to pay", "value metric", "packaging tiers", "good better best pricing", "subscription vs usage pricing", or "price before product". Helps design products customers will pay for and choose pricing models that capture value. Based on Madhavan Ramanujam's Monetizing Innovation framework from Simon-Kucher.
wdavidturner/product-skills/monetizing-i.descriptionCn: 当被问及“定价策略”、“支付意愿”、“价值指标”、“包装等级”、“好更好的最佳定价”、“订阅与使用定价”或“产品之前的价格”时使用。帮助设计客户愿意付费的产品并选择能够获取价值的定价模型。基于 Simon-Kucher Madhavan Ramanujam 的货币化创新框架。

wdavidturner/product-skills/okrs.title: okrs
wdavidturner/product-skills/okrs.description: Use when asked to "set OKRs", "objectives and key results", "quarterly OKR planning", "align objectives", "measure OKR progress", or "focus priorities with OKRs". Helps teams focus on what matters most and create a cadence of progress. The OKR framework (originated by Andy Grove at Intel, popularized by John Doerr at Google) creates alignment, focus, and learning cycles. Christina Wodtke's Radical Focus approach emphasizes simplicity and avoiding common pitfalls.
wdavidturner/product-skills/okrs.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "set OKRs", "objectives and key results", "quarterly OKR planning", "align objectives", "measure OKR progress", or "focus priorities with OKRs". Helps teams focus on what matters most and create a cadence of progress. The OKR framework (originated by Andy Grove at Intel, popularized by John Doerr at Google) creates alignment, focus, and learning cycles. Christina Wodtke's Radical Focus approach emphasizes simplicity and avoiding common pitfalls.
wdavidturner/product-skills/okrs.descriptionCn: 当被要求“设定 OKR”、“目标和关键结果”、“季度 OKR 规划”、“调整目标”、“衡量 OKR 进度”或“通过 OKR 关注优先事项”时使用。帮助团队专注于最重要的事情并创造进步的节奏。 OKR 框架（由英特尔的安迪·格罗夫 (Andy Grove) 发起，由谷歌的约翰·杜尔 (John Doerr) 推广）创建了一致性、焦点和学习周期。 Christina Wodtke 的激进聚焦方法强调简单性并避免常见的陷阱。

wdavidturner/product-skills/opportunity-.title: opportunity-solution-trees
wdavidturner/product-skills/opportunity-.description: Use when asked to "opportunity solution tree", "OST", "Teresa Torres", "map customer opportunities to outcomes", "structure discovery around opportunities", or "compare solutions for a customer need". Helps product teams connect outcomes to customer opportunities and test solutions with Opportunity Solution Trees (created by Teresa Torres).
wdavidturner/product-skills/opportunity-.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "opportunity solution tree", "OST", "Teresa Torres", "map customer opportunities to outcomes", "structure discovery around opportunities", or "compare solutions for a customer need". Helps product teams connect outcomes to customer opportunities and test solutions with Opportunity Solution Trees (created by Teresa Torres).
wdavidturner/product-skills/opportunity-.descriptionCn: 当被要求“机会解决方案树”、“OST”、“Teresa Torres”、“将客户机会映射到结果”、“围绕机会构建发现”或“比较客户需求的解决方案”时使用。帮助产品团队将结果与客户机会联系起来，并使用机会解决方案树（由 Teresa Torres 创建）测试解决方案。

wdavidturner/product-skills/pmf-survey.title: pmf-survey
wdavidturner/product-skills/pmf-survey.description: Use when asked to "PMF survey", "measure product-market fit", "40% rule", "Sean Ellis test", "Rahul Vohra method", or "how disappointed would you be". Helps quantify product-market fit and systematically improve it. The PMF Survey framework (created by Sean Ellis, popularized by Rahul Vohra at Superhuman) measures how disappointed users would be without your product and turns that data into a roadmap.
wdavidturner/product-skills/pmf-survey.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "PMF survey", "measure product-market fit", "40% rule", "Sean Ellis test", "Rahul Vohra method", or "how disappointed would you be". Helps quantify product-market fit and systematically improve it. The PMF Survey framework (created by Sean Ellis, popularized by Rahul Vohra at Superhuman) measures how disappointed users would be without your product and turns that data into a roadmap.
wdavidturner/product-skills/pmf-survey.descriptionCn: 当被要求“PMF 调查”、“衡量产品市场契合度”、“40% 规则”、“Sean Ellis 测试”、“Rahul Vohra 方法”或“您会感到多么失望”时使用。帮助量化产品与市场的契合度并系统地改进它。 PMF 调查框架（由 Sean Ellis 创建，由 Super human 的 Rahul Vohra 推广）衡量如果没有您的产品，用户会有多失望，并将这些数据转化为路线图。

wdavidturner/product-skills/positioning-.title: positioning-canvas
wdavidturner/product-skills/positioning-.description: Use when asked to "position my product", "positioning canvas", "differentiate from competitors", "figure out our category", "repositioning", or "why customers should pick us". Helps define competitive alternatives, differentiated value, target customers, and market category. April Dunford's positioning framework from "Obviously Awesome" makes your product's value obvious to the right customers.
wdavidturner/product-skills/positioning-.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "position my product", "positioning canvas", "differentiate from competitors", "figure out our category", "repositioning", or "why customers should pick us". Helps define competitive alternatives, differentiated value, target customers, and market category. April Dunford's positioning framework from "Obviously Awesome" makes your product's value obvious to the right customers.
wdavidturner/product-skills/positioning-.descriptionCn: 当被要求“定位我的产品”、“定位画布”、“与竞争对手区分开来”、“弄清楚我们的类别”、“重新定位”或“为什么客户应该选择我们”时使用。帮助定义有竞争力的替代方案、差异化价值、目标客户和市场类别。 April Dunford 的“Obviously Awesome”定位框架使您的产品价值对合适的客户来说是显而易见的。

wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.title: product-led-growth
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.description: Use when asked about "product-led growth", "PLG strategy", "self-serve growth", "freemium model", "free trial design", "product-led sales", "PQL", or "bottoms-up growth". Helps design and optimize product-led growth motions where the product drives acquisition, activation, and monetization. Based on frameworks from Elena Verna and Hila Qu.
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.descriptionEn: Use when asked about "product-led growth", "PLG strategy", "self-serve growth", "freemium model", "free trial design", "product-led sales", "PQL", or "bottoms-up growth". Helps design and optimize product-led growth motions where the product drives acquisition, activation, and monetization. Based on frameworks from Elena Verna and Hila Qu.
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.descriptionCn: 当被问及“产品主导的增长”、“PLG 策略”、“自助增长”、“免费增值模式”、“免费试用设计”、“产品主导的销售”、“PQL”或“自下而上的增长”时使用。帮助设计和优化以产品为主导的增长动作，其中产品推动获取、激活和货币化。基于 Elena Verna 和 Hila Qu 的框架。

wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.title: product-led-seo
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.description: Use when asked to "product-led SEO", "programmatic SEO", "build programmatic pages", "organic acquisition for product", "decide if SEO is worth it", or "optimize for AI search". Helps evaluate whether SEO fits your business model and how to approach it as a product, not just marketing. The Product-Led SEO framework (created by Eli Schwartz) treats SEO as building products for search users.
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "product-led SEO", "programmatic SEO", "build programmatic pages", "organic acquisition for product", "decide if SEO is worth it", or "optimize for AI search". Helps evaluate whether SEO fits your business model and how to approach it as a product, not just marketing. The Product-Led SEO framework (created by Eli Schwartz) treats SEO as building products for search users.
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.descriptionCn: 当被要求“以产品为主导的 SEO”、“程序化 SEO”、“构建程序化页面”、“产品的有机获取”、“决定 SEO 是否值得”或“优化 AI 搜索”时使用。帮助评估 SEO 是否适合您的商业模式以及如何将其作为产品而不仅仅是营销。以产品为主导的 SEO 框架（由 Eli Schwartz 创建）将 SEO 视为为搜索用户构建产品。

wdavidturner/product-skills/radical-cand.title: radical-candor
wdavidturner/product-skills/radical-cand.description: Use when asked to "radical candor", "give feedback that cares", "have a difficult conversation", "challenge directly", "manage performance issues", or "give praise that lands". Helps deliver direct feedback while showing you care. The Radical Candor framework (created by Kim Scott) teaches how to challenge directly while caring personally.
wdavidturner/product-skills/radical-cand.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "radical candor", "give feedback that cares", "have a difficult conversation", "challenge directly", "manage performance issues", or "give praise that lands". Helps deliver direct feedback while showing you care. The Radical Candor framework (created by Kim Scott) teaches how to challenge directly while caring personally.
wdavidturner/product-skills/radical-cand.descriptionCn: 当被要求“彻底坦率”、“提供关心的反馈”、“进行一次艰难的对话”、“直接挑战”、“管理绩效问题”或“给予有效的赞扬”时使用。帮助提供直接反馈，同时向您表示关心。 Radical Candor 框架（由 Kim Scott 创建）教导如何在关心个人的同时直接挑战。

wdavidturner/product-skills/seven-powers.title: seven-powers
wdavidturner/product-skills/seven-powers.description: Use when asked to "7 Powers", "build a competitive moat", "analyze defensibility", "find sustainable advantage", "economic moats", or "Hamilton Helmer framework". Helps identify durable competitive advantages. The 7 Powers framework (created by Hamilton Helmer) reveals the economic structures that protect business value from competition.
wdavidturner/product-skills/seven-powers.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "7 Powers", "build a competitive moat", "analyze defensibility", "find sustainable advantage", "economic moats", or "Hamilton Helmer framework". Helps identify durable competitive advantages. The 7 Powers framework (created by Hamilton Helmer) reveals the economic structures that protect business value from competition.
wdavidturner/product-skills/seven-powers.descriptionCn: 当被要求“七大力量”、“建立竞争护城河”、“分析防御性”、“寻找可持续优势”、“经济护城河”或“汉密尔顿·赫尔默框架”时使用。帮助确定持久的竞争优势。七权框架（由 Hamilton Helmer 创建）揭示了保护商业价值免受竞争的经济结构。

wdavidturner/product-skills/shape-up.title: shape-up
wdavidturner/product-skills/shape-up.description: Use when asked to "shape up", "run a shaping session", "set an appetite", "scope a project without estimates", "betting table", or "ship in fixed cycles". Helps teams escape estimate-driven development and Scrum fatigue. The Shape Up method (created by Ryan Singer at Basecamp/37signals) uses fixed time boxes, variable scope, and collaborative shaping to ship meaningful work predictably.
wdavidturner/product-skills/shape-up.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "shape up", "run a shaping session", "set an appetite", "scope a project without estimates", "betting table", or "ship in fixed cycles". wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-calendar.title: wecomcli-calendar
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-calendar.description: 企业微信日程管理。当用户需要预约日程、预订会议室、查看/更新/取消日程或查忙闲时触发。本技能负责『日程』——即不含在线会议链接的安排（也涵盖纯线下面对面碰头）；若用户要的是『在线会议』（含会议号/入会链接、可远程或视频参会），改用 wecomcli-meeting 技能。用户仅说'开会/约个会/某会'等、未明确要创建的是日程还是在线会议时，必须先读取本技能并按其中的消歧流程向用户追问确认后再处理，不可臆断直接创建。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-calendar.descriptionEn: 企业微信日程管理。当用户需要预约日程、预订会议室、查看/更新/取消日程或查忙闲时触发。本技能负责『日程』——即不含在线会议链接的安排（也涵盖纯线下面对面碰头）；若用户要的是『在线会议』（含会议号/入会链接、可远程或视频参会），改用 wecomcli-meeting 技能。用户仅说'开会/约个会/某会'等、未明确要创建的是日程还是在线会议时，必须先读取本技能并按其中的消歧流程向用户追问确认后再处理，不可臆断直接创建。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-calendar.descriptionCn: 企业微信日程管理。当用户需要预订日程、预订会议室、查看/更新/取消日程或检查可用性时会触发它。该技能处理“日程安排”——不包括在线会议链接的安排（也涵盖纯粹的线下面对面聚会）；如果用户想要“在线会议”（包括会议号码/加入链接、远程或视频参与），请改用 wecomcli-meeting 技能。当用户只说“开会”、“安排会议”、“某个会议”等，而没有明确表明是创建日程还是在线会议时，系统必须先调用该技能并按照其消歧流程询问用户确认后再继续，而不能直接假设创建。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-contact.descriptionEn: 通讯录成员查询技能，获取当前用户可见范围内的通讯录成员，支持按姓名/别名本地筛选匹配。返回 userid、姓名和别名。⚠️ 仅返回当前用户有权限查看的成员，非全量成员。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-disk.title: wecomcli-disk
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-disk.description: 企业微信微盘（Disk / 网盘）文件操作技能。承接"微盘 / 网盘"里的文件列出、搜索、读取元信息、上传、下载、重命名、新建文件夹操作。用户明确提到"微盘"/"网盘"/"共享空间"时必须先读取本技能获取完整指引，不得凭记忆处理。用户说"上传到微盘"、"帮我在微盘里搜一下 xxx"、"微盘那个 PPT 在哪"、"下载微盘那个文件"、"把微盘那个文件重命名成 xxx"、或直接给出 `https://drive.weixin.qq.com/s?k=...` 形式的微盘文件链接时使用本技能。与 `wecomcli-doc` / `wecomcli-sheet` / `wecomcli-smartsheet` / `wecomcli-smartpage` 的区别：本技能处理微盘里所有文件（含在线文档）的搜索/列表/基础信息/位置/路径/重命名等文件级操作；在线文档（`doc/sheet/smartsheet/smartpage` 类型）的内容读写走对应文档技能，不由本技能接管。当用户问「这个文档在微盘哪里」或问某文件在微盘的位置时，由本技能用 get 返回空间名/文件夹名/路径等元信息。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-disk.descriptionEn: 企业微信微盘（Disk / 网盘）文件操作技能。承接"微盘 / 网盘"里的文件列出、搜索、读取元信息、上传、下载、重命名、新建文件夹操作。用户明确提到"微盘"/"网盘"/"共享空间"时必须先读取本技能获取完整指引，不得凭记忆处理。用户说"上传到微盘"、"帮我在微盘里搜一下 xxx"、"微盘那个 PPT 在哪"、"下载微盘那个文件"、"把微盘那个文件重命名成 xxx"、或直接给出 `https://drive.weixin.qq.com/s?k=...` 形式的微盘文件链接时使用本技能。与 `wecomcli-doc` / `wecomcli-sheet` / `wecomcli-smartsheet` / `wecomcli-smartpage` 的区别：本技能处理微盘里所有文件（含在线文档）的搜索/列表/基础信息/位置/路径/重命名等文件级操作；在线文档（`doc/sheet/smartsheet/smartpage` 类型）的内容读写走对应文档技能，不由本技能接管。当用户问「这个文档在微盘哪里」或问某文件在微盘的位置时，由本技能用 get 返回空间名/文件夹名/路径等元信息。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-disk.descriptionCn:
企业微信盘（盘/网盘）文件操作技巧。处理“磁盘/网络磁盘”中的文件列表、搜索、读取元数据、上传、下载、重命名和创建文件夹操作。当用户明确提及“磁盘”/“网盘”/“共享空间”时，必须首先查阅该技能以获得完整的指导；你不能依赖记忆。当用户说“上传到磁盘”、“帮我查找磁盘中的xxx”、“磁盘中那个PPT在哪里”、“下载那个磁盘文件”、“将该磁盘文件重命名为xxx”，或者提供一个“https://drive.weixin.qq.com/s?k=...”样式的磁盘文件链接时，就必须使用这个技能。  

与 `wecomcli-doc` / `wecomcli-sheet` / `wecomcli-smartsheet` / `wecomcli-smartpage` 的区别：该技能处理磁盘中每个文件（包括在线文档）的所有文件级操作（搜索/列表/基本信息/位置/路径/重命名等）。在线文档（类型“doc/sheet/smartsheet/smartpage”）的内容读/写由相应的文档技能处理，而不是由本技能处理。  

当用户询问“此文档在磁盘中的位置”或查询文件在磁盘中的位置时，此技能应通过 GET 请求返回空间名称、文件夹名称和路径等元数据。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-doc.title: wecomcli-doc
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-doc.description: 企业微信文档与智能表格管理技能。提供文档的创建、读取、编辑能力，以及智能表格的结构管理（子表、字段）和数据管理（记录增删改查）。适用场景：(1) 以 Markdown 格式获取文档完整内容 (2) 新建文档或智能表格 (3) 用 Markdown 格式覆写文档内容 (4) 管理智能表格子表和字段/列 (5) 查询、添加、更新、删除智能表格记录。支持通过 docid 或文档 URL 定位文档。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-doc.descriptionEn: 企业微信文档与智能表格管理技能。提供文档的创建、读取、编辑能力，以及智能表格的结构管理（子表、字段）和数据管理（记录增删改查）。适用场景：(1) 以 Markdown 格式获取文档完整内容 (2) 新建文档或智能表格 (3) 用 Markdown 格式覆写文档内容 (4) 管理智能表格子表和字段/列 (5) 查询、添加、更新、删除智能表格记录。支持通过 docid 或文档 URL 定位文档。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-doc.descriptionCn: 微信工作文档与智能餐桌管理技巧。提供文档创建、阅读和编辑功能，以及智能表结构管理（工作表、字段）和数据管理（记录增删改查）。适用场景： (1) 检索 Markdown 格式的完整文档内容 (2) 创建新文档或智能表格 (3) 覆盖 Markdown 格式的文档内容 (4) 管理智能表格表和字段/列 (5) 查询、添加、更新和删除智能表格记录。支持通过docid或文档URL定位文档。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-doc-manage.title: wecomcli-doc-manage
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-doc-manage.description: 企业微信文档公共管理：搜索文档（最近浏览/创建）、文档改名、添加文档成员权限、设置文档加入规则。适用于所有文档类型（doc文档 / 在线表格 / 智能表格 / 智能文档）。新建或导入doc文档请使用 wecomcli-doc；新建或导入在线表格请使用 wecomcli-sheet；智能表格内容 CRUD 请使用 wecomcli-smartsheet；生成智能文档请使用 wecomcli-smartpage。"看过哪些文档/浏览历史"类需求走本技能，不要走 wecom_get_user_memory。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-doc-manage.descriptionEn: 企业微信文档公共管理：搜索文档（最近浏览/创建）、文档改名、添加文档成员权限、设置文档加入规则。适用于所有文档类型（doc文档 / 在线表格 / 智能表格 / 智能文档）。新建或导入doc文档请使用 wecomcli-doc；新建或导入在线表格请使用 wecomcli-sheet；智能表格内容 CRUD 请使用 wecomcli-smartsheet；生成智能文档请使用 wecomcli-smartpage。"看过哪些文档/浏览历史"类需求走本技能，不要走 wecom_get_user_memory。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-doc-manage.descriptionCn: 企业微信文档公共管理：搜索文档（最近查看/创建）、重命名文档、添加文档成员权限、设置文档加入规则。适用于所有文档类型（doc文档/在线表格/智能表格/智能文档）。使用wecomcli-doc创建或导入doc文档；使用wecomcli-sheet创建或导入在线工作表；使用wecomcli-smartsheet对智能表内容进行CRUD操作；并使用wecomcli-smartpage生成智能文档。 “浏览过哪些文档/浏览历史记录”类型的请求应该由该技能处理，而不是由wecom_get_user_memory处理。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-edit-todo.title: wecomcli-edit-todo
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-edit-todo.description: 企业微信待办事项编辑技能，支持创建、更新、删除待办及变更用户处理进度状态。在用户说"帮我创建一个待办"、"把这个任务分派给张三"、"标记待办完成"、"删掉那个待办"、"帮我建个提醒"、"更新一下待办内容"、"把提醒时间改到下周"、"接受这个待办"、"拒绝这个待办"等需要对待办进行写操作的场景时使用。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-edit-todo.descriptionEn: 企业微信待办事项编辑技能，支持创建、更新、删除待办及变更用户处理进度状态。在用户说"帮我创建一个待办"、"把这个任务分派给张三"、"标记待办完成"、"删掉那个待办"、"帮我建个提醒"、"更新一下待办内容"、"把提醒时间改到下周"、"接受这个待办"、"拒绝这个待办"等需要对待办进行写操作的场景时使用。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-email.title: wecomcli-email
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-email.description: 企业微信邮件：发送/回复/转发邮件、搜索邮件列表、获取邮件详情（正文、附件、内嵌图片解析），支持通过邮件发送日程邀约和会议预定。当用户涉及内部邮件收发、邮件查询、邮件管理等需求时使用。注意：日程和会议有单独的技能，仅当用户明确提到"邮箱"或"邮件"时（如"通过邮箱发送会议邀请"、"发封会议邮件"），才使用本技能处理会议日程邮件。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-email.descriptionEn: 企业微信邮件：发送/回复/转发邮件、搜索邮件列表、获取邮件详情（正文、附件、内嵌图片解析），支持通过邮件发送日程邀约和会议预定。当用户涉及内部邮件收发、邮件查询、邮件管理等需求时使用。注意：日程和会议有单独的技能，仅当用户明确提到"邮箱"或"邮件"时（如"通过邮箱发送会议邀请"、"发封会议邮件"），才使用本技能处理会议日程邮件。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-email.descriptionCn: 企业微信邮件：发送/回复/转发电子邮件，搜索电子邮件列表，检索电子邮件详细信息（正文、附件、嵌入图像解析），支持通过电子邮件发送日历邀请和会议预订。当用户有内部邮件收发、邮件查询、邮件管理等相关需求时使用。 注意：日历和会议有不同的技能；仅当用户明确提及“邮箱”或“电子邮件”（例如，“通过电子邮件发送会议邀请”、“发送会议电子邮件”）时，才应使用此技能来处理会议日历电子邮件。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-meeting.title: wecomcli-get-meeting
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-meeting.description: 企业微信会议查询技能, 支持查询会议列表, 获取会议详情, 按关键词查找会议. 当用户需要"查看会议", "查询会议列表", "会议详情", "什么时候开会", "有哪些会议", "查找会议"时触发.
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-meeting.descriptionEn: 企业微信会议查询技能, 支持查询会议列表, 获取会议详情, 按关键词查找会议. 当用户需要"查看会议", "查询会议列表", "会议详情", "什么时候开会", "有哪些会议", "查找会议"时触发.
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-meeting.descriptionCn: 企业微信会议查询技能，支持查询会议列表、获取会议详情、通过关键字搜索会议。当用户需要“查看会议”、“查询会议列表”、“会议详情”、“会议时间”、“有哪些会议”、“搜索会议”时触发。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-msg.title: wecomcli-get-msg
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-msg.description: 企业微信消息技能。提供会话列表查询、消息记录拉取（支持文本/图片/文件/语音/视频）、多媒体文件获取和文本消息发送能力。当用户需要"查看消息"、"看聊天记录"、"发消息给某人"、"最近有什么消息"、"给群里发消息"、"看看发了什么图片/文件"时触发。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-msg.descriptionEn: 企业微信消息技能。提供会话列表查询、消息记录拉取（支持文本/图片/文件/语音/视频）、多媒体文件获取和文本消息发送能力。当用户需要"查看消息"、"看聊天记录"、"发消息给某人"、"最近有什么消息"、"给群里发消息"、"看看发了什么图片/文件"时触发。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-msg.descriptionCn: 企业微信消息传递技巧。提供会话列表查询、历史消息检索（支持文本/图片/文件/语音/视频）、多媒体文件提取、短信发送。当用户需要“查看消息”、“检查聊天记录”、“向某人发送消息”、“查看最近的消息”、“向群组发送消息”或“查看发送了哪些图像/文件”时触发。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-todo-de.title: wecomcli-get-todo-detail
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-todo-de.description: 企业微信待办详情批量查询技能，根据待办 ID 列表获取完整信息（包含待办内容和分派人）。在用户说"看看这个待办的详情"、"待办内容是什么"、"这个待办分派给谁了"、"告诉我待办的具体信息"等需要查看待办完整内容的场景时使用。通常配合 wecomcli-get-todo-list 使用——先获取待办 ID 列表，再用本技能获取详情。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-todo-de.descriptionEn: 企业微信待办详情批量查询技能，根据待办 ID 列表获取完整信息（包含待办内容和分派人）。在用户说"看看这个待办的详情"、"待办内容是什么"、"这个待办分派给谁了"、"告诉我待办的具体信息"等需要查看待办完整内容的场景时使用。通常配合 wecomcli-get-todo-list 使用——先获取待办 ID 列表，再用本技能获取详情。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-todo-de.descriptionCn: 企业微信待办事项批量查询技巧：根据待办事项ID列表检索完整信息（包括待办事项内容和受托人）。当用户说“检查此待办事项的详细信息”、“待办事项内容是什么”、“此待办事项分配给谁”、“告诉我待办事项的具体信息”或类似的查看完整内容的请求时使用。通常与 wecomcli-get-todo-list 一起使用——首先获取待办事项 ID 列表，然后使用此技能获取详细信息。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-todo-li.title: wecomcli-get-todo-list
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-todo-li.description: 企业微信待办列表查询技能，支持按创建时间和提醒时间过滤，支持分页。在用户说"看看我的待办列表"、"我有哪些待办"、"这周的待办有哪些"、"最近有什么待办"、"查一下我的待办"、"列出所有待办"等需要浏览待办概览的场景时使用。注意：此技能仅返回待办概要信息（不含内容和分派人），如需完整详情请配合 wecomcli-get-todo-detail 使用。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-todo-li.descriptionEn: 企业微信待办列表查询技能，支持按创建时间和提醒时间过滤，支持分页。在用户说"看看我的待办列表"、"我有哪些待办"、"这周的待办有哪些"、"最近有什么待办"、"查一下我的待办"、"列出所有待办"等需要浏览待办概览的场景时使用。注意：此技能仅返回待办概要信息（不含内容和分派人），如需完整详情请配合 wecomcli-get-todo-detail 使用。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-get-todo-li.descriptionCn: 企业微信待办事项查询技巧，支持按创建时间和提醒时间过滤，支持分页。当用户说“检查我的待办事项列表”、“我有哪些待办事项”、“本周的待办事项”、“最近的待办事项”、“查找我的待办事项”、“列出所有待办事项”或任何需要待办事项概述的场景时，请使用此选项。注意：该技能仅返回摘要信息（不包括内容和受让人）；有关完整详细信息，请使用 wecomcli-get-todo-detail。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-lookup-cont.title: wecomcli-lookup-contact
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-lookup-cont.description: 通讯录成员查询技能，获取当前用户可见范围内的通讯录成员，支持按姓名/别名本地筛选匹配。返回 userid、姓名和别名。⚠️ 仅返回当前用户有权限查看的成员，非全量成员。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-lookup-cont.descriptionEn: 通讯录成员查询技能，获取当前用户可见范围内的通讯录成员，支持按姓名/别名本地筛选匹配。返回 userid、姓名和别名。⚠️ 仅返回当前用户有权限查看的成员，非全量成员。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-lookup-cont.descriptionCn: 通讯录成员查询技巧：检索当前用户可见的通讯录中的成员，并按姓名/别名进行本地过滤。返回用户 ID、名称和别名。 ⚠️ 仅返回当前用户有权查看的成员，而不是完整列表。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-doc.title: wecomcli-manage-doc
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-doc.description: 企业微信文档管理技能。提供文档的创建、读取和编辑能力，支持通过 docid 或文档 URL 操作企业微信文档（doc_type=3）和智能表格（doc_type=10）。适用场景：(1) 以 Markdown 格式导出获取文档完整内容（异步轮询） (2) 新建文档或智能表格 (3) 用 Markdown 格式覆写文档内容。当用户需要查看文档内容、创建新文档、编辑文档正文时触发此 Skill。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-doc.descriptionEn: 企业微信文档管理技能。提供文档的创建、读取和编辑能力，支持通过 docid 或文档 URL 操作企业微信文档（doc_type=3）和智能表格（doc_type=10）。适用场景：(1) 以 Markdown 格式导出获取文档完整内容（异步轮询） (2) 新建文档或智能表格 (3) 用 Markdown 格式覆写文档内容。当用户需要查看文档内容、创建新文档、编辑文档正文时触发此 Skill。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-doc.descriptionCn: Enterprise WeChat document management skills.提供创建、读取、编辑文档的能力，支持通过docid或文档URL对企业微信文档（doc_type=3）和智能表格（doc_type=10）进行操作。适用场景：（1）导出Markdown格式完整内容（异步轮询）（2）新建文档或智能表格（3）覆盖Markdown格式文档内容。当用户需要查看文档内容、创建新文档或编辑文档正文时，会触发此技能。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-sche.title: wecomcli-manage-schedule
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-sche.description: 企业微信日程管理技能。适用于用户对企业微信日程的各类管理需求。当用户需要：(1) 查询指定时间范围内的日程列表或获取日程详细信息（标题、时间、地点、参与者等），(2) 创建新日程并设置提醒、参与人等，(3) 修改已有日程的标题、时间、地点等信息或取消日程，(4) 添加或移除日程参与人，(5) 查询多个成员的闲忙状态并分析共同空闲时段以安排会议时使用此技能。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-sche.descriptionEn: 企业微信日程管理技能。适用于用户对企业微信日程的各类管理需求。当用户需要：(1) 查询指定时间范围内的日程列表或获取日程详细信息（标题、时间、地点、参与者等），(2) 创建新日程并设置提醒、参与人等，(3) 修改已有日程的标题、时间、地点等信息或取消日程，(4) 添加或移除日程参与人，(5) 查询多个成员的闲忙状态并分析共同空闲时段以安排会议时使用此技能。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-sche.descriptionCn: 企业微信日历管理技巧。适合用户在企业微信中管理日历的所有需求。当用户需要：（1）查询指定时间范围内的事件列表或获取详细的事件信息（标题、时间、地点、参与者等），（2）创建新事件并设置提醒和参与者，（3）修改现有事件的标题、时间、地点或其他信息或取消事件，（4）添加或删除事件参与者，（5）检查多个成员的空闲状态并分析常见的空闲时间段以安排会议。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-smar.title: wecomcli-manage-smartsheet-data
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-smar.description: 企业微信智能表格数据（记录）管理技能。提供智能表格记录的增删改查能力。适用场景：(1) 查询子表全部记录 (2) 添加一行或多行记录 (3) 更新已有记录 (4) 删除记录。当用户需要读取表格数据、写入新数据、修改或删除表格行时触发此 Skill。支持通过 docid 或文档 URL 定位文档。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-smar.descriptionEn: 企业微信智能表格数据（记录）管理技能。提供智能表格记录的增删改查能力。适用场景：(1) 查询子表全部记录 (2) 添加一行或多行记录 (3) 更新已有记录 (4) 删除记录。当用户需要读取表格数据、写入新数据、修改或删除表格行时触发此 Skill。支持通过 docid 或文档 URL 定位文档。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-smar.descriptionCn: 企业微信智能表数据（记录）管理技能。提供智能表记录的添加、删除、更新、查询功能。适用场景：（1）查询子表中的所有记录（2）添加一行或多行记录（3）更新现有记录（4）删除记录。当用户需要读取表数据、写入新数据、修改或删除表行时，会触发该技能。支持通过docid或文档URL定位文档。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-smar.title: wecomcli-manage-smartsheet-schema
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-smar.description: 企业微信智能表格结构管理技能。提供子表（Sheet）和字段（Field/列）的增删改查能力。适用场景：(1) 查询智能表格的子表列表 (2) 添加、更新、删除子表 (3) 查询子表的字段/列信息 (4) 添加、更新、删除字段/列。当用户需要管理智能表格的表结构、列定义、子表配置时触发此 Skill。支持通过 docid 或文档 URL 定位文档。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-smar.descriptionEn: 企业微信智能表格结构管理技能。提供子表（Sheet）和字段（Field/列）的增删改查能力。适用场景：(1) 查询智能表格的子表列表 (2) 添加、更新、删除子表 (3) 查询子表的字段/列信息 (4) 添加、更新、删除字段/列。当用户需要管理智能表格的表结构、列定义、子表配置时触发此 Skill。支持通过 docid 或文档 URL 定位文档。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-manage-smar.descriptionCn: 企业微信智能表结构管理技巧。提供工作表和字段/列的创建、读取、更新和删除功能。适用场景：（1）查询智能表中的表单列表（2）添加、更新、删除表单（3）查询表单的字段/列信息（4）添加、更新、删除字段/列。当用户需要管理智能表的结构、列定义或工作表配置时，会触发此技能。支持通过docid或文档URL定位文档。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-media.title: wecomcli-media
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-media.description: 企业微信媒体文件上传/下载技能。承接基于 media_id 下载媒体文件到本地，以及上传本地文件获取 media_id 两类操作。当其他技能（微盘、邮件等）返回了 media_id 需要落地为本地文件，或已有本地文件需要转换为 media_id 供其他技能使用时，必须先读取本技能获取完整指引，不得凭记忆处理。本技能不解析/识别文件内容，仅负责文件本身的搬运。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-media.descriptionEn: 企业微信媒体文件上传/下载技能。承接基于 media_id 下载媒体文件到本地，以及上传本地文件获取 media_id 两类操作。当其他技能（微盘、邮件等）返回了 media_id 需要落地为本地文件，或已有本地文件需要转换为 media_id 供其他技能使用时，必须先读取本技能获取完整指引，不得凭记忆处理。本技能不解析/识别文件内容，仅负责文件本身的搬运。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-media.descriptionCn: 企业微信媒体文件上传/下载能力。它处理两种类型的操作：使用media_id将媒体文件下载到本地存储，以及上传本地文件以获取media_id。当其他能力（如微盘、邮件等）返回需要物化为本地文件的media_id时，或者需要将已有的本地文件转换为media_id供其他能力使用时，必须先查阅该技能的完整指南，不能依赖记忆。该技能不会解析或识别文件内容；它全权负责文件本身的传输。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-meeting.title: wecomcli-meeting
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-meeting.description: 企业微信会议技能，支持创建预约会议、查询会议列表、获取会议详情、取消会议、更新会议成员。当用户需要"创建会议"、"预约会议"、"约会议"、"安排会议"、"查看会议"、"查询会议列表"、"会议详情"、"什么时候开会"、"有哪些会议"、"查找会议"、"取消会议"、"删除会议"、"修改会议成员"、"添加会议参与人"、"移除会议成员"时触发。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-meeting.descriptionEn: 企业微信会议技能，支持创建预约会议、查询会议列表、获取会议详情、取消会议、更新会议成员。当用户需要"创建会议"、"预约会议"、"约会议"、"安排会议"、"查看会议"、"查询会议列表"、"会议详情"、"什么时候开会"、"有哪些会议"、"查找会议"、"取消会议"、"删除会议"、"修改会议成员"、"添加会议参与人"、"移除会议成员"时触发。
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-meeting.descriptionCn: 企业微信会议功能支持创建预约会议、查询会议列表、检索会议详情、取消会议、更新会议参加者等。当用户需要“创建会议”、“安排会议”、“安排会议”、“查看会议”、“查询会议列表”、“获取会议详细信息”、“会议时间”、“有哪些会议”、“查找会议”、“取消会议”、“删除会议”、“修改会议参与者”、“添加会议与会者”或“删除会议成员”时，会触发该事件。

wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-message.title: wecomcli-message
wecomteam/wecom-cli/wecomcli-message.description: 查询当前可以发送消息的聊天会话范围，并向会话列表中的单聊或群聊发送文本、Markdown、图片、文件、语音、视频消息。用户要求“给某人发消息”“在某个群里通知”“给最近会话发消息”或“把图片/文件/语音/视频发到企业微信”时使用。

（1）查询指定时间范围内的日程列表或获取活动详情（名称、时间、地点、参与者等）；

wedneyyuri/databricks-repl/databricks-re.title: databricks-repl
wedneyyuri/databricks-repl/databricks-re.description: Execute Python code on a Databricks cluster via a stateful REPL session. Use this skill when the user wants to run Python on Databricks, perform data analysis with Spark, train models on a cluster, query Unity Catalog tables, use sub_llm() for recursive LM calls, or any task requiring a persistent Databricks execution context. Always use a dedicated --project-dir (e.g., examples/my-task/) to isolate session.json and repl_outputs per task. Covers session lifecycle (create, exec, await, cancel, destroy), output file management, and eviction recovery.
wedneyyuri/databricks-repl/databricks-re.descriptionEn: Execute Python code on a Databricks cluster via a stateful REPL session. Use this skill when the user wants to run Python on Databricks, perform data analysis with Spark, train models on a cluster, query Unity Catalog tables, use sub_llm() for recursive LM calls, or any task requiring a persistent Databricks execution context. Always use a dedicated --project-dir (e.g., examples/my-task/) to isolate session.json and repl_outputs per task. Covers session lifecycle (create, exec, await, cancel, destroy), output file management, and eviction recovery.
wedneyyuri/databricks-repl/databricks-re.descriptionCn: 通过有状态 REPL 会话在 Databricks 集群上执行 Python 代码。当用户想要在 Databricks 上运行 Python、使用 Spark 执行数据分析、在集群上训练模型、查询 Unity Catalog 表、使用 sub_llm() 进行递归 LM 调用或任何需要持久 Databricks 执行上下文的任务时，请使用此技能。始终使用专用的 --project-dir （例如，examples/my-task/）来隔离每个任务的 session.json 和 repl_outputs。涵盖会话生命周期（创建、执行、等待、取消、销毁）、输出文件管理和驱逐恢复。

wedneyyuri/databricks-repl/databricks-re.title: databricks-repl-consolidate
wedneyyuri/databricks-repl/databricks-re.description: Consolidate a Databricks REPL session into a single, clean Python file. Use this skill when the user wants to finalize, export, or consolidate a REPL session into a committable script. wgpsec/aboutsecurity/adcs-certipy-attack.descriptionCn: Active Directory 证书服务 (ADCS) 证书攻击。当在域中发现 CA 服务器、ADCS Web 注册或配置错误的证书模板时使用。涵盖所有证书滥用路径 ESC1‑ESC11、Certipy 工具链、证书伪造和到 ADCS 的 NTLM 中继。当发现 ADCS/CA/certificate/certsrv 相关内容时，必须采用此技术。

wgpsec/aboutsecurity/agent-security.title: agent-security

wgpsec/aboutsecurity/mapcidr-cidr.title: mapcidr-cidr
wgpsec/aboutsecurity/mapcidr-cidr.description: 使用 mapcidr 进行 CIDR 网段处理。当需要展开 CIDR 为 IP 列表、聚合 IP 为 CIDR、切片网段、IP 数量统计、打乱 IP 顺序时使用。mapcidr 是 ProjectDiscovery 出品的 CIDR 处理工具，支持 IPv4/IPv6。任何涉及 CIDR 计算、IP 列表处理、网段切片的场景都应使用此技能
wgpsec/aboutsecurity/mapcidr-cidr.descriptionEn: 使用 mapcidr 进行 CIDR 网段处理。当需要展开 CIDR 为 IP 列表、聚合 IP 为 CIDR、切片网段、IP 数量统计、打乱 IP 顺序时使用。mapcidr 是 ProjectDiscovery 出品的 CIDR 处理工具，支持 IPv4/IPv6。任何涉及 CIDR 计算、IP 列表处理、网段切片的场景都应使用此技能
wgpsec/aboutsecurity/mapcidr-cidr.descriptionCn: 使用mapcidr进行CIDR网段处理。当您需要将 CIDR 扩展到 IP 列表、将 IP 聚合到 CIDR、对网段进行切片、对 IP 进行计数或随机化 IP 顺序时，请使用它。 mapcidr 是 ProjectDiscovery 的 CIDR 处理工具，支持 IPv4/IPv6。任何涉及 CIDR 计算、IP 列表处理或网段切片的场景都应该使用此功能。

wgpsec/aboutsecurity/masscan-scan.title: masscan-scan
wgpsec/aboutsecurity/masscan-scan.description: 使用 masscan 进行超大规模高速端口扫描。当需要扫描大范围 CIDR 网段、全互联网规模扫描时使用。masscan 是异步无状态扫描器，速度可达每秒百万包级别，适合大规模资产发现。需要 root 权限。任何涉及大规模网段扫描、高速端口发现、互联网测绘的场景都应使用此技能
wgpsec/aboutsecurity/masscan-scan.descriptionEn: 使用 masscan 进行超大规模高速端口扫描。当需要扫描大范围 CIDR 网段、全互联网规模扫描时使用。masscan 是异步无状态扫描器，速度可达每秒百万包级别，适合大规模资产发现。需要 root 权限。任何涉及大规模网段扫描、高速端口发现、互联网测绘的场景都应使用此技能
wgpsec/aboutsecurity/masscan-scan.descriptionCn: 使用masscan进行超大规模高速端口扫描。它在扫描广泛的 CIDR 范围或进行全互联网扫描时使用。 Masscan 是一种异步、无状态扫描器，可以达到每秒数百万个数据包的速度，使其适合大规模资产发现。需要 root 权限。任何涉及大规模网段扫描、高速端口检测或互联网映射的场景都应该使用此功能。

wgpsec/aboutsecurity/mcp-security.title: mcp-security
wgpsec/aboutsecurity/mcp-security.description:
MCP (Model Context Protocol) 协议安全测试方法论。当目标环境使用 MCP Server 集成外部工具、
需要评估 MCP 工具描述安全性、或测试 Agent 通过 MCP 调用工具时的安全边界时触发。
覆盖: 工具描述投毒、地毯式骗局(动态篡改)、指令覆盖(Shadow Tool)、隐藏指令(ANSI/Unicode)、
跨 Server 攻击、Token 窃取、Schema 操纵、上下文溢出。
wgpsec/aboutsecurity/mcp-security.descriptionEn:
MCP (Model Context Protocol) 协议安全测试方法论。当目标环境使用 MCP Server 集成外部工具、
需要评估 MCP 工具描述安全性、或测试 Agent 通过 MCP 调用工具时的安全边界时触发。
覆盖: 工具描述投毒、地毯式骗局(动态篡改)、指令覆盖(Shadow Tool)、隐藏指令(ANSI/Unicode)、
跨 Server 攻击、Token 窃取、Schema 操纵、上下文溢出。
wgpsec/aboutsecurity/mcp-security.descriptionCn: MCP（模型上下文协议）协议安全测试方法。当目标环境使用MCP Server集成外部工具、需要评估MCP工具描述的安全性、或者Agent通过MCP调用工具时测试安全边界时触发。覆盖范围：工具描述中毒、地毯式诈骗（动态篡改）、命令覆盖（Shadow Tool）、隐藏命令（ANSI/Unicode）、跨服务器攻击、令牌盗窃、模式操纵、上下文溢出。

wgpsec/aboutsecurity/memory-forensics-ev.title: memory-forensics-evasion
wgpsec/aboutsecurity/memory-forensics-ev.description: 内存取证与反内存取证方法论。从蓝队视角理解内存取证如何发现恶意行为（Volatility3 分析流程），从红队视角掌握如何规避内存检测（进程隐藏、内存加密、痕迹清除）。当需要分析内存 dump 或设计反取证策略时使用
wgpsec/aboutsecurity/memory-forensics-ev.descriptionEn: 内存取证与反内存取证方法论。从蓝队视角理解内存取证如何发现恶意行为（Volatility3 分析流程），从红队视角掌握如何规避内存检测（进程隐藏、内存加密、痕迹清除）。当需要分析内存 dump 或设计反取证策略时使用

wgstecnologia/impeccable/impeccable.title: impeccable
wgstecnologia/impeccable/impeccable.description: Use when the user wants to design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, clarify, distill, harden, optimize, adapt, animate, colorize, extract, or otherwise improve a frontend interface. Covers websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, settings, onboarding, and empty states. Handles UX review, visual hierarchy, information architecture, cognitive load, accessibility, performance, responsive behavior, theming, anti-patterns, typography, fonts, spacing, layout, alignment, color, motion, micro-interactions, UX copy, error states, edge cases, i18n, and reusable design systems or tokens. Also use for bland designs that need to become bolder or more delightful, loud designs that should become quieter, live browser iteration on UI elements, or ambitious visual effects that should feel technically extraordinary. Not for backend-only or non-UI tasks.

Also use for bland designs that need to become bolder or more delightful, loud designs that should become quieter, live browser iteration on UI elements, or ambitious visual effects that should feel technically extraordinary. wgstecnologia/impeccable/impeccable.descriptionCn: 当用户想要设计、重新设计、塑造、批评、审核、抛光、澄清、提炼、强化、优化、适应、动画、着色、提取或以其他方式改进前端界面时使用。涵盖网站、登陆页面、仪表板、产品 UI、应用程序外壳、组件、表单、设置、入门和空状态。处理用户体验审查、视觉层次结构、信息架构、认知负荷、可访问性、性能、响应行为、主题、反模式、排版、字体、间距、布局、对齐、颜色、运动、微交互、用户体验复制、错误状态、边缘情况、i18n 和可重用设计系统或令牌。还可以用于需要变得更大胆或更令人愉悦的平淡设计、应该变得更安静的响亮设计、UI 元素上的实时浏览器迭代，或者应该在技术上感觉非凡的雄心勃勃的视觉效果。不适用于仅后端或非 UI 任务。

Triggers on tasks involving adversarial analysis, threat modeling, attack scenarios, attack vectors, exploit analysis, or red team review.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: deliverable-selfloop
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:

**Trigger**: self loop, self-loop, polish deliverable, quality gate, fix-on-fail, 收敛, 自循环, 质量门.
**Use when**: A pipeline has produced a reader-facing deliverable (`output/*.md`) and you want deterministic convergence to PASS.
**Skip if**: You are still pre-approval for prose or the upstream evidence/structure artifacts are missing.
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: Do not invent papers/citations/results. Only use in-scope inputs already present in the workspace.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: draft-polisher
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Audit-style editing pass for `output/DRAFT.md`: remove template boilerplate, improve coherence, and enforce citation anchoring.
**Trigger**: polish draft, de-template, coherence pass, remove boilerplate, 润色, 去套话, 去重复, 统一术语.
**Use when**: a first-pass draft exists but reads like scaffolding (repetition/ellipsis/template phrases) or needs a coherence pass before global review/LaTeX.
**Skip if**: the draft already reads human-grade and passes quality gates; or prose is not approved in `DECISIONS.md`.
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not add/remove/invent citation keys; do not move citations across subsections; do not change claims beyond what existing citations support.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: evaluation-anchor-checker
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Audit and rewrite evaluation/numeric claims to ensure they carry minimal protocol context (task + metric + constraint) and avoid underspecified model naming.
**Trigger**: evaluation anchor checker, numeric claim hygiene, underspecified numbers, protocol context, 评测锚点检查, 数字断言, 指标上下文.
**Use when**: before final merge/polish, or when reviewers would likely flag claims as underspecified (numbers without task/metric/budget), or `pipeline-auditor` warns about suspicious model naming.
**Skip if**: evidence is too thin to justify numeric claims (route upstream to C3/C4), or you are pre-C2 (NO PROSE).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not invent numbers; do not add/remove/move citation keys; if protocol context is missing, weaken/remove the numeric claim rather than guessing.

**触发器**：评估锚点检查器、数字声明卫生、未指定的数字、协议上下文、足球变量点检查、数字断言、指标上下文。

**Trigger**: limitation weaver, rewrite limitations, remove two limitations, 去Two limitations, 局限改写, caveat rewrite.
**Use when**: `writer-selfloop` is PASS but flags repeated count-based limitation openers in `output/WRITER_SELFLOOP_TODO.md`, or multiple H3s share the same limitation cadence.
**Skip if**: the limitation is evidence-missing (route upstream), or you are pre-C2 (NO PROSE).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not invent facts; do not add/remove/move citation keys; do not delete subsection-specific limitations; keep claim→evidence anchoring intact.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: literature-engineer
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:

**Trigger**: evidence collector, literature engineer, 文献扩充, 多路召回, snowballing, cited by, references, 元信息增强, provenance.
**Use when**: 需要把候选文献扩充到 ≥1200 篇并补齐可追溯 meta（survey pipeline 的 Stage C1，写作前置 evidence）。
**Skip if**: 已经有高质量 `papers/papers_raw.jsonl`（≥1200 且每条都有稳定标识+来源记录）。
**Network**: 可离线（靠 imports）；雪崩/在线检索需要网络。
**Guardrail**: 不允许编造论文；每条记录必须带稳定标识（arXiv id / DOI / 可信 URL）和 provenance；不写 output/ prose。

**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not invent facts; do not add/remove citation keys; do not move citations across subsections; keep section-level claims consistent with `output/ARGUMENT_SKELETON.md# Consistency Contract`.

wimolivier/postgresql-best-practices/pos.title: postgresql-best-practices
wimolivier/postgresql-best-practices/pos.description:
PostgreSQL 18+ comprehensive best practices for enterprise database development. Provides schema
architecture patterns, Table API design, PL/pgSQL coding standards, migrations, and data warehousing.

USE THIS SKILL WHEN THE USER:
- Creates PostgreSQL schemas, tables, functions, procedures, or triggers
- Asks about PostgreSQL data types (uuid, text, timestamptz, jsonb, numeric)
- Writes PL/pgSQL code and needs naming conventions (l_, in_, io_, co_ prefixes)
- Implements Table API pattern (SECURITY DEFINER functions, schema separation)
- Sets up database migrations or schema versioning
- Needs index optimization, constraint design, or query performance help
- Asks about PostgreSQL 18+ features (uuidv7, virtual columns, temporal constraints)
- Builds data warehouses with Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
- Needs data lineage tracking, ETL patterns, or audit logging
- Reviews database code for best practices or anti-patterns
- Migrates from Oracle PL/SQL to PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL
- Sets up CI/CD pipelines for database changes

CORE PATTERNS:
- Three-schema separation: data (tables) → private (internal) → api (external)
- Table API: All access through SECURITY DEFINER functions with SET search_path
- Native migration system: Pure PL/pgSQL alternative to Flyway/Liquibase
- Trivadis naming: l_ (local), in_ (input), io_ (inout), co_ (constant)

wimolivier/postgresql-best-practices/pos.descriptionCn:
PostgreSQL 18+ 企业数据库开发的全面最佳实践。提供架构
架构模式、表 API 设计、PL/pgSQL 编码标准、迁移和数据仓库。

当用户出现以下情况时使用此技能：
- 创建 PostgreSQL 模式、表、函数、过程或触发器
- 询问 PostgreSQL 数据类型（uuid、text、timestamptz、jsonb、numeric）
- 编写 PL/pgSQL 代码并需要命名约定（l_、in_、io_、co_ 前缀）
- 实现表 API 模式（SECURITY DEFINER 函数、模式分离）
- 设置数据库迁移或架构版本控制
- 需要索引优化、约束设计或查询性能帮助
- 询问 PostgreSQL 18+ 功能（uuidv7、虚拟列、时间约束）
- 使用 Medallion 架构构建数据仓库（铜牌/银牌/金牌）
- 需要数据沿袭跟踪、ETL 模式或审核日志记录
- 审查数据库代码的最佳实践或反模式
- 从 Oracle PL/SQL 迁移到 PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL
- 为数据库更改设置 CI/CD 管道

核心模式：
- 三模式分离：数据（表）→私有（内部）→api（外部）
- 表 API：通过带有 SET search_path 的 SECURITY DEFINER 函数进行所有访问
- 原生迁移系统：Flyway/Liquibase 的纯 PL/pgSQL 替代方案
- Trivadis 命名：l_（本地）、in_（输入）、io_（输入输出）、co_（常量）

wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/dcf-.title: dcf-model
wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/dcf-.description: Real DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) model creation for equity valuation. Retrieves financial data from SEC filings and analyst reports, builds comprehensive cash flow projections with proper WACC calculations, performs sensitivity analysis, and outputs professional Excel models with executive summaries. Use when users need to value a company using DCF methodology, request intrinsic value analysis, or ask for detailed financial modeling with growth projections and terminal value calculations.
wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/dcf-.descriptionEn: Real DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) model creation for equity valuation. Use when users need to value a company using DCF methodology, request intrinsic value analysis, or ask for detailed financial modeling with growth projections and terminal value calculations.
wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/dcf-.descriptionCn: 用于股权估值的真实 DCF（贴现现金流）模型创建。从 SEC 文件和分析师报告中检索财务数据，通过适当的 WACC 计算构建全面的现金流预测，执行敏感性分析，并输出带有执行摘要的专业 Excel 模型。当用户需要使用 DCF 方法对公司进行估值、要求进行内在价值分析或要求提供包含增长预测和终值计算的详细财务模型时使用。

wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/divi.descriptionCn: 识别股息持续增长、经营质量稳定、估值回落至合理区间的候选个股，以及产出进入观察区、增长支撑位和失败边界。这适用于盈利与成长双目标选择、长期配置、回调定位等场景。

wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/earn.title: earnings_calendar_planner_skill

wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/earn.title: earnings_momentum_setup_skill

wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/earn.title: earnings_preview_skill

wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/intr.title: intraday_abnormal_move_alert_skill

wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/intr.descriptionCn: 识别日内异常波动，如快速上涨、急剧下跌、成交量激增和成交量突然变化，并快速解释其可能的驱动因素、持续性和关键应对点。这适用于评估异常的真实性、剖析这些驱动因素的来源以及在监控市场的同时决定是否继续跟踪等场景。

wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/majo.descriptionEn: 分析并购、减持、定增、重大合同等公告的影响路径、受益受损方与后续风险。适用于突发公告解读、盘后复盘、事件驱动判断等场景。

wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/mana.title: management_quality_check_skill
wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/mana.description: 快速检查管理层背景、激励机制、资本配置、治理质量与潜在红旗信号，判断是否值得给予管理层信用。适用于公司治理研究、长线票筛选、研究前风险排查等场景。

wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/mark.descriptionEn: 判断指数上涨或下跌背后是否有足够市场广度支撑，识别行情是健康扩散、局部抱团还是虚弱反弹。适用于大盘健康度评估、指数行情辨别与仓位判断。

wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/mark.title: market_regime_switch_skill
wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/mark.description: 判断市场处于进攻、防守、震荡或切换阶段，并解释风格、广度、情绪与宏观环境的匹配关系。适用于总仓位决策、风格选择与阶段策略更新。

wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/mark.description: 量化市场情绪冷热、风险偏好与交易拥挤度，帮助判断当前市场处于亢奋、均衡、谨慎还是恐慌状态。适用于仓位决策、节奏判断与情绪复盘。

wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/moat.title: moat_strength_review_skill

wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/nort.title: northbound_capital_flow_skill

wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/pead.title: pead_opportunity_skill
wind-information-co-ltd/wind-skills/pead.description: 识别财报后漂移行情中值得跟踪的中短线机会，判断预期修正、价格延续与失效边界。适用于财报后趋势交易、业绩惊喜跟踪、事件后候选池管理等场景。
