zereight/skill/zereight-react-native-opt.description: React Native performance review checklist for code reviews. Use when reviewing RN code to detect rendering, animation, and native performance regressions. Complements zereight-review — run both together on RN PRs.
zereight/skill/zereight-react-native-opt.descriptionEn: React Native performance review checklist for code reviews. Use when reviewing RN code to detect rendering, animation, and native performance regressions. Complements zereight-review — run both together on RN PRs.
zereight/skill/zereight-react-native-opt.descriptionCn: 用于代码审查的 React Native 性能审查清单。在检查 RN 代码时使用以检测渲染、动画和本机性能回归。补充 zereight-review — 在 RN PR 上同时运行两者。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/chains.title: chains
zeriontech/zerion-ai/chains.description: List blockchain networks supported by Zerion. Use when validating chain names, checking supported networks, or looking up chain metadata before querying wallet data.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/chains.descriptionEn: List blockchain networks supported by Zerion. Use when validating chain names, checking supported networks, or looking up chain metadata before querying wallet data.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/chains.descriptionCn: 列出 Zerion 支持的区块链网络。在验证链名称、检查支持的网络或在查询钱包数据之前查找链元数据时使用。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/wallet-analysis.title: wallet-analysis
zeriontech/zerion-ai/wallet-analysis.description: Analyze any crypto wallet: portfolio value, token holdings, DeFi positions, transactions, and PnL. Supports ENS names and the chain IDs currently accepted by zerion-cli.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/wallet-analysis.descriptionEn: Analyze any crypto wallet: portfolio value, token holdings, DeFi positions, transactions, and PnL. Supports ENS names and the chain IDs currently accepted by zerion-cli.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/wallet-analysis.descriptionCn: 分析任何加密钱包：投资组合价值、代币持有量、DeFi 头寸、交易和盈亏。支持 zerion-cli 目前接受的 ENS 名称和链 ID。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/wallet-trading.title: wallet-trading
zeriontech/zerion-ai/wallet-trading.description: Trade crypto tokens: swap, bridge across 14 chains. Manage wallets, agent tokens, and security policies.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/wallet-trading.descriptionEn: Trade crypto tokens: swap, bridge across 14 chains. Manage wallets, agent tokens, and security policies.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/wallet-trading.descriptionCn: 交易加密代币：交换、跨越 14 条链。管理钱包、代理令牌和安全策略。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion.title: zerion
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion.description: Install, configure, and troubleshoot zerion — the unified CLI for wallet analysis and autonomous trading. Covers setup, authentication (API key, x402, agent tokens), wallet management, and the end-to-end agent workflow.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion.descriptionEn: Install, configure, and troubleshoot zerion — the unified CLI for wallet analysis and autonomous trading. Covers setup, authentication (API key, x402, agent tokens), wallet management, and the end-to-end agent workflow.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion.descriptionCn: 安装、配置 zerion 并进行故障排除 — 用于钱包分析和自主交易的统一 CLI。涵盖设置、身份验证（API 密钥、x402、代理令牌）、钱包管理和端到端代理工作流程。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-agent-manage.title: zerion-agent-management
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-agent-manage.description: Manage Zerion agent tokens and security policies — the primitives for autonomous trading and signing. Create / list / use / revoke agent tokens; create / list / show / delete policies (chain locks, allowlists, transfer/approval gates, expiry). Use whenever the user asks to set up an agent token, configure a policy, or enable autonomous trading. Required by `zerion-trading` and `zerion-sign`.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-agent-manage.descriptionEn: Manage Zerion agent tokens and security policies — the primitives for autonomous trading and signing. Create / list / use / revoke agent tokens; create / list / show / delete policies (chain locks, allowlists, transfer/approval gates, expiry). Use whenever the user asks to set up an agent token, configure a policy, or enable autonomous trading. Required by `zerion-trading` and `zerion-sign`.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-agent-manage.descriptionCn: 管理 Zerion 代理代币和安全策略——自主交易和签名的原语。创建/列出/使用/撤销代理令牌；创建/列出/显示/删除策略（链锁、允许列表、转移/批准门、到期）。每当用户要求设置代理令牌、配置策略或启用自主交易时使用。 `zerion-trading` 和 `zerion-sign` 需要。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-analyze.title: zerion-analyze
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-analyze.description: Read-only crypto wallet insights via the Zerion CLI: portfolio value, token holdings, DeFi positions, transaction history, PnL, and watchlist management. Use whenever the user asks 'what's in this wallet', 'how is X doing', portfolio/PnL/positions/transactions for any address, ENS name, local wallet, or watched address. Supports x402 / MPP pay-per-call. Pair with `zerion-trading` for execution after analysis.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-analyze.descriptionEn: Read-only crypto wallet insights via the Zerion CLI: portfolio value, token holdings, DeFi positions, transaction history, PnL, and watchlist management. Use whenever the user asks 'what's in this wallet', 'how is X doing', portfolio/PnL/positions/transactions for any address, ENS name, local wallet, or watched address. Supports x402 / MPP pay-per-call. Pair with `zerion-trading` for execution after analysis.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-analyze.descriptionCn: 通过 Zerion CLI 获得只读加密钱包见解：投资组合价值、代币持有量、DeFi 头寸、交易历史、盈亏和观察列表管理。每当用户询问“这个钱包里有什么”、“X 怎么样”、任何地址、ENS 名称、本地钱包或监视地址的投资组合/损益/头寸/交易时使用。支持x402/MPP 按次付费。与“zerion-trading”配对以在分析后执行。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-bankr.title: zerion-bankr
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-bankr.description: Research wallets with Zerion CLI (portfolios, positions, PnL, history across 41+ chains), then execute every action with Bankr — spot swaps, cross-chain bridges, DCA/limit/stop-loss automation, Hyperliquid leverage, Polymarket bets, transfers, NFT trades, and token deployment. Bankr signs and broadcasts from its own multi-chain wallet (Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, Unichain); Zerion stays read-only.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-bankr.descriptionEn: Research wallets with Zerion CLI (portfolios, positions, PnL, history across 41+ chains), then execute every action with Bankr — spot swaps, cross-chain bridges, DCA/limit/stop-loss automation, Hyperliquid leverage, Polymarket bets, transfers, NFT trades, and token deployment. Bankr signs and broadcasts from its own multi-chain wallet (Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, Unichain); Zerion stays read-only.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-bankr.descriptionCn: 使用 Zerion CLI 研究钱包（超过 41 条链的投资组合、仓位、盈亏、历史记录），然后使用 Bankr 执行每项操作 — 现货互换、跨链桥接、DCA/限价/止损自动化、超流动性杠杆、Polymarket 投注、转账、NFT 交易和代币部署。 Bankr 从自己的多链钱包（Base、Ethereum、Polygon、Solana、Unichain）进行签名和广播； Zerion 保持只读状态。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-cli.title: zerion-cli
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-cli.description: Install, configure, and troubleshoot the Zerion CLI for crypto wallet data. Use when setting up authentication, checking CLI status, or debugging connection issues. For actual wallet queries, use the wallet-analysis skill.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-cli.descriptionEn: Install, configure, and troubleshoot the Zerion CLI for crypto wallet data. Use when setting up authentication, checking CLI status, or debugging connection issues. For actual wallet queries, use the wallet-analysis skill.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-cli.descriptionCn: 为加密钱包数据安装、配置 Zerion CLI 并对其进行故障排除。在设置身份验证、检查 CLI 状态或调试连接问题时使用。对于实际的钱包查询，请使用钱包分析技能。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-lifi-earn.title: zerion-lifi-earn
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-lifi-earn.description: Discover yield vaults across 20+ chains and deposit into them from any chain in one transaction using the LI.FI Earn API for vault discovery and LI.FI Composer-powered execution. Zerion CLI funds the wallet beforehand and verifies the resulting DeFi position. Use when the user asks to 'find the best vault', 'deposit into a vault', 'earn yield on Base/Polygon/Ethereum', 'bridge and stake', 'put tokens into DeFi', or 'discover top APY for USDC'. Covers ERC-4626 vaults and major lending markets — coverage varies by chain.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-lifi-earn.descriptionEn: Discover yield vaults across 20+ chains and deposit into them from any chain in one transaction using the LI.FI Earn API for vault discovery and LI.FI Composer-powered execution. Zerion CLI funds the wallet beforehand and verifies the resulting DeFi position. Use when the user asks to 'find the best vault', 'deposit into a vault', 'earn yield on Base/Polygon/Ethereum', 'bridge and stake', 'put tokens into DeFi', or 'discover top APY for USDC'. Covers ERC-4626 vaults and major lending markets — coverage varies by chain.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-lifi-earn.descriptionCn: 使用 LI.FI Earn API 进行金库发现和 LI.FI Composer 支持的执行，发现 20 多个链上的收益金库，并在一笔交易中从任何链将资金存入其中。 Zerion CLI 预先为钱包提供资金并验证由此产生的 DeFi 头寸。当用户要求“找到最好的金库”、“存入金库”、“在 Base/Polygon/Ethereum 上赚取收益”、“桥接和质押”、“将代币放入 DeFi”或“发现 USDC 的最高 APY”时使用。涵盖 ERC-4626 金库和主要借贷市场——覆盖范围因链而异。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-monad-addres.title: zerion-monad-addresses
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-monad-addres.description: Canonical Monad mainnet smart contract addresses for use with Zerion CLI: bridged stablecoins (USDC, USDT0, USD1, AUSD), wrapped MON, signing canonicals (Permit2, ERC-4337, ERC-6492), wallet primitives (Multicall3, Safe), ERC-8004 trustless-agent registries, and DEX / aggregator / cross-chain router addresses for `zerion agent create-policy --allowlist` lockdown. Points at the official monad-crypto/token-list and monad-crypto/protocols repos as authoritative fallbacks, with a one-line `cast code` verification recipe before any address is used.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-monad-addres.descriptionEn: Canonical Monad mainnet smart contract addresses for use with Zerion CLI: bridged stablecoins (USDC, USDT0, USD1, AUSD), wrapped MON, signing canonicals (Permit2, ERC-4337, ERC-6492), wallet primitives (Multicall3, Safe), ERC-8004 trustless-agent registries, and DEX / aggregator / cross-chain router addresses for `zerion agent create-policy --allowlist` lockdown. Points at the official monad-crypto/token-list and monad-crypto/protocols repos as authoritative fallbacks, with a one-line `cast code` verification recipe before any address is used.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-monad-addres.descriptionCn: 与 Zerion CLI 一起使用的 Canonical Monad 主网智能合约地址：桥接稳定币（USDC、USDT0、USD1、AUSD）、包装 MON、签名规范（Permit2、ERC-4337、ERC-6492）、钱包原语（Multicall3、Safe）、ERC-8004 无信任代理注册表以及“zerion 代理创建策略”的 DEX/聚合器/跨链路由器地址--allowlist`锁定。指向官方 monad-crypto/token-list 和 monad-crypto/protocols 存储库作为权威后备，在使用任何地址之前使用一行“强制转换代码”验证配方。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-partner-skil.title: zerion-partner-skill-creator
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-partner-skil.description: Guide for partners contributing skills to zerion-ai. Explains how to combine your product with Zerion CLI commands in a single SKILL.md.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-partner-skil.descriptionEn: Guide for partners contributing skills to zerion-ai. Explains how to combine your product with Zerion CLI commands in a single SKILL.md.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-partner-skil.descriptionCn: 为 zerion-ai 贡献技能的合作伙伴指南。解释如何在单个 SKILL.md 中将您的产品与 Zerion CLI 命令结合起来。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-sendai-ideas.title: zerion-sendai-ideas
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-sendai-ideas.description: Crypto idea discovery, validation, competitive landscape, and DeFi market research — adapted from SendAI's solana-new idea skills. Use when a user asks 'what should I build in crypto', 'validate this idea', 'who are my competitors', 'show me TVL data', or wants a structured interview/scoring/landscape pass on a crypto product idea. SendAI surfaces the idea; the Zerion CLI (`zerion analyze`, `zerion history`, `zerion positions`) provides on-chain validation before you build.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-sendai-ideas.descriptionEn: Crypto idea discovery, validation, competitive landscape, and DeFi market research — adapted from SendAI's solana-new idea skills. Use when a user asks 'what should I build in crypto', 'validate this idea', 'who are my competitors', 'show me TVL data', or wants a structured interview/scoring/landscape pass on a crypto product idea. SendAI surfaces the idea; the Zerion CLI (`zerion analyze`, `zerion history`, `zerion positions`) provides on-chain validation before you build.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-sendai-ideas.descriptionCn: 加密创意发现、验证、竞争格局和 DeFi 市场研究——改编自 SendAI 的 solana 新创意技能。当用户询问“我应该在加密货币中构建什么”、“验证这个想法”、“谁是我的竞争对手”、“向我展示 TVL 数据”，或者想要对加密产品想法进行结构化面试/评分/景观传递时使用。 SendAI 提出了这个想法； Zerion CLI（“zerionanalyze”、“zerionhistory”、“zerionpositions”）在构建之前提供链上验证。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-trading.title: zerion-trading
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-trading.description: Execute on-chain trading actions via the Zerion CLI: swap, bridge, and send tokens across 14 EVM chains and Solana. Use whenever the user asks to swap / trade / convert tokens, bridge across chains, or transfer tokens to an address. Always uses an API key + agent token (no pay-per-call). Pair with `zerion-agent-management` to set up tokens/policies first, and `zerion-analyze` to check positions before trading.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-trading.descriptionEn: Execute on-chain trading actions via the Zerion CLI: swap, bridge, and send tokens across 14 EVM chains and Solana. Use whenever the user asks to swap / trade / convert tokens, bridge across chains, or transfer tokens to an address. Always uses an API key + agent token (no pay-per-call). Pair with `zerion-agent-management` to set up tokens/policies first, and `zerion-analyze` to check positions before trading.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-trading.descriptionCn: 通过 Zerion CLI 执行链上交易操作：在 14 个 EVM 链和 Solana 之间交换、桥接和发送代币。每当用户要求交换/交易/转换代币、跨链桥接或将代币转移到某个地址时使用。始终使用 API 密钥 + 代理令牌（无需按次付费）。与“zerion-agent-management”配对，首先设置代币/策略，并与“zerion-analyze”配对，在交易前检查仓位。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-trails-cross.title: zerion-trails-crosschainswap
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-trails-cross.description: Cross-chain token swaps to and from Polygon (chainId 137) using the Trails SDK, with Zerion CLI on top for funding and portfolio checks. Use when the user wants to bridge or swap tokens across chains where Polygon is the source or destination — e.g. 'swap ETH on Ethereum to USDC on Polygon', 'bridge USDC from Arbitrum to Polygon', or 'swap to POL from any chain'. Supports Widget (drop-in React UI), Headless hooks (custom UX), and Direct API (server-side) integration modes.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-trails-cross.descriptionEn: Cross-chain token swaps to and from Polygon (chainId 137) using the Trails SDK, with Zerion CLI on top for funding and portfolio checks. Use when the user wants to bridge or swap tokens across chains where Polygon is the source or destination — e.g. 'swap ETH on Ethereum to USDC on Polygon', 'bridge USDC from Arbitrum to Polygon', or 'swap to POL from any chain'. Supports Widget (drop-in React UI), Headless hooks (custom UX), and Direct API (server-side) integration modes.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-trails-cross.descriptionCn: 使用 Trails SDK 与 Polygon（chainId 137）进行跨链代币交换，并在顶部使用 Zerion CLI 进行资金和投资组合检查。当用户想要在 Polygon 为源或目的地的链之间桥接或交换代币时使用 - 例如“将以太坊上的 ETH 交换到 Polygon 上的 USDC”、“将 USDC 从 Arbitrum 桥接到 Polygon”或“从任何链交换到 POL”。支持 Widget（嵌入式 React UI）、Headless hooks（自定义 UX）和 Direct API（服务器端）集成模式。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-trails-depos.title: zerion-trails-deposit
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-trails-depos.description: Deposit tokens into DeFi vaults on Polygon (chainId 137) using the Trails SDK, with Zerion CLI on top for funding and portfolio checks. Handles cross-chain bridging + vault deposit in a single intent: user sends tokens from any chain and they land directly in the vault. Supports Aave, Morpho, and custom ERC-4626 vaults via composable actions or calldata. Use when the user asks to 'deposit into a vault', 'earn yield on Polygon', 'bridge and stake', or 'put tokens into a DeFi protocol on Polygon'.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-trails-depos.descriptionEn: Deposit tokens into DeFi vaults on Polygon (chainId 137) using the Trails SDK, with Zerion CLI on top for funding and portfolio checks. Handles cross-chain bridging + vault deposit in a single intent: user sends tokens from any chain and they land directly in the vault. Supports Aave, Morpho, and custom ERC-4626 vaults via composable actions or calldata. Use when the user asks to 'deposit into a vault', 'earn yield on Polygon', 'bridge and stake', or 'put tokens into a DeFi protocol on Polygon'.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-trails-depos.descriptionCn: 使用 Trails SDK 将代币存入 Polygon（chainId 137）上的 DeFi 金库，并在顶部使用 Zerion CLI 进行融资和投资组合检查。以单一意图处理跨链桥接 + 金库存款：用户从任何链发送代币，然后直接进入金库。通过可组合操作或调用数据支持 Aave、Morpho 和自定义 ERC-4626 金库。当用户要求“存入金库”、“在 Polygon 上赚取收益”、“桥接和质押”或“将代币放入 Polygon 上的 DeFi 协议”时使用。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-uniswap-x402.title: zerion-uniswap-x402
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-uniswap-x402.description: Pay HTTP 402 (x402) payment challenges using any token via Uniswap swaps, with Zerion CLI handling cross-chain balance checks and optional bridging beforehand.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-uniswap-x402.descriptionEn: Pay HTTP 402 (x402) payment challenges using any token via Uniswap swaps, with Zerion CLI handling cross-chain balance checks and optional bridging beforehand.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-uniswap-x402.descriptionCn: 通过 Uniswap 交换使用任何代币支付 HTTP 402 (x402) 支付挑战，并使用 Zerion CLI 预先处理跨链余额检查和可选的桥接。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-vaultsfyi-ma.title: zerion-vaultsfyi-market-intel
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-vaultsfyi-ma.description: Get the current state of the DeFi yield market using vaults.fyi benchmark rates, compare vaults side-by-side, evaluate curators, and check how a Zerion wallet's positions stack up against market rates.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-vaultsfyi-ma.descriptionEn: Get the current state of the DeFi yield market using vaults.fyi benchmark rates, compare vaults side-by-side, evaluate curators, and check how a Zerion wallet's positions stack up against market rates.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-vaultsfyi-ma.descriptionCn: 使用Vaults.fyi基准利率了解DeFi收益率市场的当前状态，并排比较金库，评估管理者，并检查Zerion钱包的头寸与市场利率的比较。

zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-vaultsfyi-st.title: zerion-vaultsfyi-strategist
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-vaultsfyi-st.description: Institutional-grade yield strategy analysis using vaults.fyi historical data, benchmark rate environments, share price trends, and curator track records, paired with Zerion wallet context.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-vaultsfyi-st.descriptionEn: Institutional-grade yield strategy analysis using vaults.fyi historical data, benchmark rate environments, share price trends, and curator track records, paired with Zerion wallet context.
zeriontech/zerion-ai/zerion-vaultsfyi-st.descriptionCn: 使用Vaults.fyi历史数据、基准利率环境、股价趋势和策展人跟踪记录以及Zerion钱包背景进行机构级收益策略分析。

zernie/vigiles/add-a-linter.title: add-a-linter
zernie/vigiles/add-a-linter.description: Add a new linter to vigiles's cross-referencing engine as one cohesive, type-enforced unit — a LinterAdapter in the LINTERS registry, with the conformance test enforcing docs + site parity so no site is forgotten
zernie/vigiles/add-a-linter.descriptionEn: Add a new linter to vigiles's cross-referencing engine as one cohesive, type-enforced unit — a LinterAdapter in the LINTERS registry, with the conformance test enforcing docs + site parity so no site is forgotten
zernie/vigiles/add-a-linter.descriptionCn: 将一个新的 linter 添加到 vigiles 的交叉引用引擎中，作为一个内聚的、类型强制的单元 - LINTERS 注册表中的一个 LinterAdapter，通过一致性测试强制执行文档 + 站点奇偶校验，这样就不会忘记任何站点

zernie/vigiles/adopt-spec.title: adopt-spec
zernie/vigiles/adopt-spec.description: Adopt a typed .spec.ts for an existing hand-written CLAUDE.md — start from the file you already have, non-destructively
zernie/vigiles/adopt-spec.descriptionEn: Adopt a typed .spec.ts for an existing hand-written CLAUDE.md — start from the file you already have, non-destructively
zernie/vigiles/adopt-spec.descriptionCn: 对现有的手写 CLAUDE.md 采用键入的 .spec.ts — 从您已有的文件开始，非破坏性地

zernie/vigiles/audience-check.title: audience-check
zernie/vigiles/audience-check.description: Read the README (or any front-door doc) through the eyes of several distinct audience personas and report what each would think, miss, or bounce on
zernie/vigiles/audience-check.descriptionEn: Read the README (or any front-door doc) through the eyes of several distinct audience personas and report what each would think, miss, or bounce on
zernie/vigiles/audience-check.descriptionCn: 通过几个不同受众角色的视角阅读自述文件（或任何前门文档），并报告每个人的想法、错过或反弹的内容

zernie/vigiles/audit-feedback-loop.title: audit-feedback-loop
zernie/vigiles/audit-feedback-loop.description: Scan the current repo and score its feedback loop maturity for AI-assisted development

zernie/vigiles/debug-my-harness.descriptionCn: 通过读取本地飞行记录器分类帐 (.vigiles/runs.jsonl) 来诊断代理工具行为不当的原因 — 哪些技能被触发或被劫持、哪些钩子被阻止或错误允许、发生哪些子代理工具合同违规以及技能的触发率如何变化。当被问及为什么技能停止发射、为什么钩子没有阻止、为什么运行错误的技能或调试/调查安全带实际做了什么时使用。不适用于编写新规则（使用加强）或编辑规范（使用编辑规范）。

zernie/vigiles/verify-docs-findable.title: verify-docs-findable
zernie/vigiles/verify-docs-findable.description: Audit whether a repo's docs actually ANSWER the questions a reader has — by spawning fresh, cheap (Haiku) agents that cold-read ONLY the docs and measuring how fast they reach the answer, whether they hit dead-ends, whether they fall back to source code, and whether they cite docs that contradict each other. Use after a doc reorg, when docs "feel scattered," or when the same confusion keeps recurring. Surfaces findability gaps (a corpus can be COMPLETE — every doc indexed — yet not FINDABLE) plus a prioritized fix list. Works on any repo's docs, not just this one.
zernie/vigiles/verify-docs-findable.descriptionEn: Audit whether a repo's docs actually ANSWER the questions a reader has — by spawning fresh, cheap (Haiku) agents that cold-read ONLY the docs and measuring how fast they reach the answer, whether they hit dead-ends, whether they fall back to source code, and whether they cite docs that contradict each other. Use after a doc reorg, when docs "feel scattered," or when the same confusion keeps recurring. Surfaces findability gaps (a corpus can be COMPLETE — every doc indexed — yet not FINDABLE) plus a prioritized fix list. Works on any repo's docs, not just this one.
zernie/vigiles/verify-docs-findable.descriptionCn: 审核存储库的文档是否真正回答了读者的问题 - 通过生成新鲜的、廉价的（俳句）代理，仅冷读文档并测量它们获得答案的速度，它们是否陷入死胡同，它们是否回退到源代码，以及它们是否引用相互矛盾的文档。在文档重组后、当文档“感觉分散”或当相同的混乱不断出现时使用。揭示可查找性差距（语料库可以是完整的 - 每个文档都已索引 - 但不可查找）以及优先修复列表。适用于任何存储库的文档，而不仅仅是这个。

zhanghandong/agent-estimation/agent-esti.title: agent-estimation
zhanghandong/agent-estimation/agent-esti.description: Accurately estimate AI agent work effort using the agent's own operational units (tool-call rounds) instead of human time. zhanghandong/agent-estimation/agent-esti.descriptionEn: Accurately estimate AI agent work effort using the agent's own operational units (tool-call rounds) instead of human time. Outputs a structured breakdown with round counts, risk factors, and a final wallclock conversion.
zhanghandong/agent-estimation/agent-esti.descriptionCn: 使用代理自己的操作单位（工具调用轮次）而不是人工时间来准确估计 AI 代理的工作量。当被要求估计、范围、计划或评估编码任务将花费多长时间时使用。防止代理锚定人类开发人员时间表并严重高估的常见故障模式。输出包含轮数、风险因素和最终挂钟转换的结构化细分。

zhen-bo/pragmatic-clean-code-reviewer/pr.description: Strict code review following Clean Code, Clean Architecture, and The Pragmatic Programmer  principles. Use when: (1) reviewing code or pull requests, (2) detecting code smells or  quality issues, (3) auditing architecture decisions, (4) preparing code for merge,  (5) refactoring existing code, or (6) checking adherence to SOLID, DRY, YAGNI, KISS principles. Also triggers on: "is this code good?", "check code quality", "ready to merge?",  "technical debt", "code smell", "best practices", "clean up code", "refactor review".

zhinkgit/normalskills/video-analyzer.description:
从视频中提取连续帧、然后用视觉逐帧分析画面内容的技能，专为嵌入式软件开发调试设计。
当用户需要分析装置录像、找出显示屏中的逻辑异常（数值跳位、状态异常、界面错误等）时使用此技能。

触发场景（符合其中一条即触发，不要等用户说"用视频分析技能"）：
- 用户提供了视频路径，要求分析、查问题、看哪里有异常
- 用户说视频里有"跳位""跳号""报告不连续""状态异常""数据乱跳"等现象
- 用户想从录像中找出某个具体问题发生的时间点
- 用户描述了嵌入式装置的显示屏或操作界面出现了异常，附有录像

注意：此技能不依赖预设规则——异常判断完全由 Claude 视觉分析完成，每次根据用户描述的具体现象来判断。

zhucl1006/skills/project-docs-setup.title: project-docs-setup
zhucl1006/skills/project-docs-setup.description:
项目文档结构创建助手。作为资深产品经理，通过多轮对话深入了解项目需求，分析合理性并提供最佳实践建议，最终生成完整的技术文档体系。

**使用时机：**
- 新项目启动，需要建立文档体系（推荐第一步）
- 现有项目缺少规范文档，需要补充完善
- 已有代码但缺少文档，需要根据代码回补文档
- 需要专业的产品和架构分析建议

**支持两种工作模式：**
- 模式 A：新项目文档创建（从需求到文档）
- 模式 B：代码回补文档（从代码到文档）

**与 project-workflow 的关系：**
- 本 skill 负责创建完整文档（PRD、SAD、开发指南等）
- project-workflow 负责基于文档执行开发任务
- 建议流程：project-docs-setup → project-workflow

**触发方式：**
- "创建项目文档" / "初始化项目文档" / "设置项目文档"
- "根据代码生成文档" / "回补项目文档" / "补充项目文档"
- 直接描述项目需求，如"帮我创建一个在线教育平台的文档"

Triggers on any Roblox or Luau development task, even when the user never says "docs".

zircote/sigint/trend-modeling.title: Trend Modeling

zixixr/paperconan/paperconan.title: paperconan
zixixr/paperconan/paperconan.description: Use when auditing paper source-data tables and registered image assets for statistical signals or data inconsistencies, interpreting paperconan scan.json/report.html, preparing cautious PubPeer or research-integrity notes, or finding open supplementary data from a DOI/title. Trigger on 论文数据检查, source data audit, paper data audit, suspicious numeric tables, figure review, multimodal image review, PubPeer prep, research integrity, DOI/title data fetch. Covers .xlsx/.csv/.tsv, tables in .pdf/.docx, and adaptive image review by an external multimodal Agent; not chart digitization or autonomous semantic judgment.
zixixr/paperconan/paperconan.descriptionEn: Use when auditing paper source-data tables and registered image assets for statistical signals or data inconsistencies, interpreting paperconan scan.json/report.html, preparing cautious PubPeer or research-integrity notes, or finding open supplementary data from a DOI/title. Trigger on 论文数据检查, source data audit, paper data audit, suspicious numeric tables, figure review, multimodal image review, PubPeer prep, research integrity, DOI/title data fetch. Covers .xlsx/.csv/.tsv, tables in .pdf/.docx, and adaptive image review by an external multimodal Agent; not chart digitization or autonomous semantic judgment.
zixixr/paperconan/paperconan.descriptionCn: 在审核纸质源数据表和注册图像资产是否存在统计信号或数据不一致、解释 paperconan scan.json/report.html、准备谨慎的 PubPeer 或研究完整性注释或从 DOI/标题查找开放补充数据时使用。触发论文数据检查、源数据审核、论文数据审核、可疑数值表、图形审核、多模态图像审核、PubPeer 准备、研究完整性、DOI/标题数据获取。涵盖 .xlsx/.csv/.tsv、.pdf/.docx 中的表格以及外部多模式代理的自适应图像审查；不是图表数字化或自主语义判断。

zixun-github/aisdlc/frontend-page-discov.title: frontend-page-discovery
zixun-github/aisdlc/frontend-page-discov.description: Use when 需要从前端代码证据化产出“页面清单→功能点→业务流程→业务规则”，且项目路由入口不唯一、动态路由/权限/后端菜单复杂、团队容易脑补或遗漏证据链时。
zixun-github/aisdlc/frontend-page-discov.descriptionEn: Use when 需要从前端代码证据化产出“页面清单→功能点→业务流程→业务规则”，且项目路由入口不唯一、动态路由/权限/后端菜单复杂、团队容易脑补或遗漏证据链时。
zixun-github/aisdlc/frontend-page-discov.descriptionCn: 当前端代码需要以“页面清单→特征点→业务流程→业务规则”的形式产生证据，并且项目有多个、非唯一的路由入口点，复杂的动态路由/权限/后端菜单，团队容易做出假设或丢失证据链时使用。

zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover.title: project-discover
zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover.description: Use when 需要对“已有代码的存量项目”做 Discover（逆向）并把仓库事实沉淀为 `.aisdlc/project/`，且你发现 AI/团队经常猜入口、猜边界、索引与细节双写、或缺证据链导致反复返工。
zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover.descriptionEn: Use when 需要对“已有代码的存量项目”做 Discover（逆向）并把仓库事实沉淀为 `.aisdlc/project/`，且你发现 AI/团队经常猜入口、猜边界、索引与细节双写、或缺证据链导致反复返工。
zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover.descriptionCn: 当您需要对现有代码库执行发现（逆向工程）并将存储库事实保存到“.aisdlc/project/”中，并且您注意到 AI/团队不断猜测入口点、边界、重复索引和细节或缺乏证据链，从而导致重复返工时，请使用此功能。

zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-mem.title: project-discover-memory-index
zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-mem.description: Use when 你已经确定了 Discover 的范围（P0/P1/P2），现在需要快速建立 `.aisdlc/project/` 的 Level-0 北极星（memory）与 Level-1 地图层索引骨架（components/products），以便后续按模块补证据而不发生双写与漂移。
zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-mem.descriptionEn: Use when 你已经确定了 Discover 的范围（P0/P1/P2），现在需要快速建立 `.aisdlc/project/` 的 Level-0 北极星（memory）与 Level-1 地图层索引骨架（components/products），以便后续按模块补证据而不发生双写与漂移。
zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-mem.descriptionCn: 当你已经确定了Discover的范围（P0/P1/P2），现在需要快速建立`.aisdlc/project/`的Level-0北极星（内存）和Level-1图层索引骨架（组件/产品）时使用，以便后续证据可以按模块添加，而不会出现双写或漂移。

zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-mod.title: project-discover-modules-contracts
zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-mod.description: Use when 你需要把选中的模块（优先 P0）做成 `.aisdlc/project/components/{module}.md` 的单页模块 SSOT，并在同一页内建立 API/Data 契约的权威入口、不变量摘要、证据入口与结构化缺口（Evidence Gaps），以满足 Discover 的 DoD 门禁。
zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-mod.descriptionEn: Use when 你需要把选中的模块（优先 P0）做成 `.aisdlc/project/components/{module}.md` 的单页模块 SSOT，并在同一页内建立 API/Data 契约的权威入口、不变量摘要、证据入口与结构化缺口（Evidence Gaps），以满足 Discover 的 DoD 门禁。
zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-mod.descriptionCn: 当您需要将选定的模块（首先是 P0）转换为位于`.aisdlc/project/components/{module}.md`的单页模块 SSOT 时使用，并在同一页面上建立 API/数据契约、不变摘要、证据条目和结构间隙（Evidence Gaps）的权威条目以满足 Discover 的 DoD 门。

zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-pre.title: project-discover-preflight-scope
zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-pre.description: Use when 你要开始存量项目 Discover，但你还不清楚“哪些入口可作为证据（run/test/ci/contract/ops）”以及“应该先做哪些模块（P0/P1/P2）”，并且担心范围失控导致不可维护。
zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-pre.descriptionEn: Use when 你要开始存量项目 Discover，但你还不清楚“哪些入口可作为证据（run/test/ci/contract/ops）”以及“应该先做哪些模块（P0/P1/P2）”，并且担心范围失控导致不可维护。
zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-pre.descriptionCn: 当您即将在遗留项目上启动 Discover，但仍然不知道“哪些入口点可以作为证据（运行/测试/ci/contract/ops）”或“首先处理哪些模块（P0/P1/P2）”，并且您担心范围蔓延会使其难以维护时，请使用。

zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-pro.title: project-discover-products-ops-dod
zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-pro.description: Use when 你已经有了 components 地图与若干模块页，现在需要收敛业务模块（products<=6）、固定运行/排障/回滚入口（ops）、并执行 DoD 门禁与增量 Discover（Delta Discover、stale 过期检测）来保证知识库可用且可维护。
zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-pro.descriptionEn: Use when 你已经有了 components 地图与若干模块页，现在需要收敛业务模块（products<=6）、固定运行/排障/回滚入口（ops）、并执行 DoD 门禁与增量 Discover（Delta Discover、stale 过期检测）来保证知识库可用且可维护。
zixun-github/aisdlc/project-discover-pro.descriptionCn: 当您已经拥有组件图和多个模块页面，并且现在需要聚合业务模块（产品 ≤ 6）、修复运行/故障排除/回滚入口点 (ops) 以及强制执行 DoD 门和增量发现（Delta Discover、过时过期检测）以保持知识库可用和可维护时使用。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-checklist.title: spec-checklist

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-checklist.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在当前 Spec Pack 中检查文档是否存在待澄清/待确认/TBD/TODO 等高价值不确定点，并用“一次只问一个问题→立刻回写文档→必要时回到扫描”的循环把不确定性收敛。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-checklist.descriptionCn: 当您需要检查当前规范包中是否有任何文档包含高价值不确定性（例如待澄清/确认/TBD/TODO 的项目）时使用，并采用“一次提出一个问题→立即更新文档→必要时返回扫描”的循环来收敛不确定性。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-design.description: Use when 需要为某个 Spec Pack 产出 D2 决策文档（RFC/Decision Doc），并在压力下仍需自主决定是否执行 D0（分流跳过设计）与 D1（可选调研），避免猜 FEATURE_DIR、脑补输入、把设计写成实现细节或遗留 TODO/待确认清单。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-design.descriptionEn: Use when 需要为某个 Spec Pack 产出 D2 决策文档（RFC/Decision Doc），并在压力下仍需自主决定是否执行 D0（分流跳过设计）与 D1（可选调研），避免猜 FEATURE_DIR、脑补输入、把设计写成实现细节或遗留 TODO/待确认清单。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-design.descriptionCn: 当您需要为规格包生成 D2 决策文档（RFC/决策文档）并且仍然必须在压力下自行决定是否执行 D0（旁路设计）和 D1（可选研究）、避免对 FEATURE_DIR 进行猜测、伪造输入、将设计转变为实现细节或留下 TODO/确认列表时使用。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-design-research.title: spec-design-research
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-design-research.description: Use when 需要在 Spec 级设计阶段执行 D1 research（产出 `{FEATURE_DIR}/design/research.md`），或面对关键不确定性/高风险点需要先验证而不是直接进入 D2；常见症状包括缺少证据支撑取舍、未知项被写成 TODO/待确认问题、在压力下想猜 FEATURE_DIR 或把调研写成实现细节。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-design-research.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在 Spec 级设计阶段执行 D1 research（产出 `{FEATURE_DIR}/design/research.md`），或面对关键不确定性/高风险点需要先验证而不是直接进入 D2；常见症状包括缺少证据支撑取舍、未知项被写成 TODO/待确认问题、在压力下想猜 FEATURE_DIR 或把调研写成实现细节。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-design-research.descriptionCn: 当需要在Spec级设计阶段进行D1研究（输出`{FEATURE_DIR}/design/research.md`）时，或者当关键不确定性/高风险点需要验证然后直接进入D2时使用；常见症状包括缺乏支持权衡的证据、将未知写为 TODO/待确认项目、感觉有压力猜测 FEATURE_DIR，或将研究写为实现细节。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-execute.title: spec-execute
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-execute.description: Use when 需要在 sdlc-dev 的 Spec Pack 中执行 I2（实现执行），以 `{FEATURE_DIR}/implementation/plan.md` 为唯一 SSOT 分批实现、运行最小验证、回写审计信息，并在批次检查点汇报；遇阻塞/澄清项立即停止。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-execute.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在 sdlc-dev 的 Spec Pack 中执行 I2（实现执行），以 `{FEATURE_DIR}/implementation/plan.md` 为唯一 SSOT 分批实现、运行最小验证、回写审计信息，并在批次检查点汇报；遇阻塞/澄清项立即停止。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-execute.descriptionCn: 当您需要在 sdlc-dev 的 Spec Pack 中执行 I2（实现执行）时使用，以 `{FEATURE_DIR}/implementation/plan.md` 作为单个 SSOT，批量实现，运行最小验证，写回审计信息，并在批量检查点报告；遇到阻碍或澄清项目时立即停止。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-implementation-.title: spec-implementation-execute
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-implementation-.description: Use when 需要在 sdlc-dev 的 Spec Pack 中执行 I2（实现执行），以 `{FEATURE_DIR}/implementation/plan.md` 为唯一 SSOT 分批实现、运行最小验证、回写审计信息，并在批次检查点汇报；遇阻塞/澄清项立即停止。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-implementation-.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在 sdlc-dev 的 Spec Pack 中执行 I2（实现执行），以 `{FEATURE_DIR}/implementation/plan.md` 为唯一 SSOT 分批实现、运行最小验证、回写审计信息，并在批次检查点汇报；遇阻塞/澄清项立即停止。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-implementation-.descriptionCn: 当您需要在 sdlc-dev 规范包中执行 I2（实现执行）时使用，使用“{FEATURE_DIR}/implementation/plan.md”作为分阶段实现的单个 SSOT、运行最少的验证、写回审计信息以及在批量检查点报告；遇到阻碍或澄清项目时立即停止。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-implementation-.title: spec-implementation-plan
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-implementation-.description: Use when 需要在 sdlc-dev 的 Spec Pack 中执行 I1（实现计划），把 requirements/design 转成 `{FEATURE_DIR}/implementation/plan.md`（唯一执行清单与状态 SSOT），并为后续 I2 执行提供无歧义任务清单。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-implementation-.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在 sdlc-dev 的 Spec Pack 中执行 I1（实现计划），把 requirements/design 转成 `{FEATURE_DIR}/implementation/plan.md`（唯一执行清单与状态 SSOT），并为后续 I2 执行提供无歧义任务清单。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-implementation-.descriptionCn: 当您需要执行 sdlc-dev 规范包中的 I1（实施计划）时使用，将需求/设计转换为“{FEATURE_DIR}/implementation/plan.md”（清单和状态的单一真实来源），并为后续 I2 执行提供明确的任务列表。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-init.title: spec-init
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-init.description: Use when 需要在本仓库的 AI SDLC 流程中初始化新的 Spec Pack（创建三位编号分支与 `.aisdlc/specs/{num}-{short-name}` 目录），或在执行 `spec-init` 时不确定输入解析、短名称规则、UTF-8 BOM 文件路径传参、脚本调用方式与输出物。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-init.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在本仓库的 AI SDLC 流程中初始化新的 Spec Pack（创建三位编号分支与 `.aisdlc/specs/{num}-{short-name}` 目录），或在执行 `spec-init` 时不确定输入解析、短名称规则、UTF-8 BOM 文件路径传参、脚本调用方式与输出物。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-init.descriptionCn: 当您需要在此存储库的 AI SDLC 进程中初始化新的规范包（创建三位数分支和“.aisdlc/specs/{num}-{short-name}”目录）时，或者在“spec-init”期间不确定输入解析、短名称规则、UTF-8 BOM 文件路径参数、脚本调用或输出时使用。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-merge-back.title: spec-merge-back
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-merge-back.description: Use when 一个 Spec Pack 已完成，需要把可复用资产晋升到 project SSOT（ADR/契约/ops/NFR/registry），且存在“整包复制污染 project / 跳过 spec-context / 把 merge-back 误当 git merge”的风险。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-merge-back.descriptionEn: Use when 一个 Spec Pack 已完成，需要把可复用资产晋升到 project SSOT（ADR/契约/ops/NFR/registry），且存在“整包复制污染 project / 跳过 spec-context / 把 merge-back 误当 git merge”的风险。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-merge-back.descriptionCn: 当规范包完成并且需要将可重用资产提升到项目 SSOT (ADR/contract/ops/NFR/registry) 时使用，存在“复制整个包并污染项目/跳过规范上下文/将合并返回为 git merge”的风险。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-pack-abandon.title: spec-pack-abandon
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-pack-abandon.description: Use when 需要因需求重大问题而废弃/撤销当前 Spec Pack，并且必须删除对应 `.aisdlc/specs/{branch}` 目录与本地/远程分支，同时需要在执行删除前输出删除清单并要求用户二次确认。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-pack-abandon.descriptionEn: Use when 需要因需求重大问题而废弃/撤销当前 Spec Pack，并且必须删除对应 `.aisdlc/specs/{branch}` 目录与本地/远程分支，同时需要在执行删除前输出删除清单并要求用户二次确认。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-pack-abandon.descriptionCn: 当由于重大需求问题而必须放弃/撤销当前规范包，并且必须删除相应的 `.aisdlc/specs/{branch}` 目录和本地/远程分支时使用。删除前，输出删除列表并需要用户确认。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-plan.title: spec-plan
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-plan.description: Use when 需要在 sdlc-dev 的 Spec Pack 中执行 I1（实现计划），把 requirements/design 转成 `{FEATURE_DIR}/implementation/plan.md`（唯一执行清单与状态 SSOT），并为后续 I2 执行提供无歧义任务清单。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-plan.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在 sdlc-dev 的 Spec Pack 中执行 I1（实现计划），把 requirements/design 转成 `{FEATURE_DIR}/implementation/plan.md`（唯一执行清单与状态 SSOT），并为后续 I2 执行提供无歧义任务清单。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-plan.descriptionCn: 当您需要执行 sdlc-dev 的 Spec Pack 中的 I1（实施计划）时使用，将需求/设计转换为“{FEATURE_DIR}/implementation/plan.md”（清单和状态的单一真实来源），并为后续 I2 执行提供明确的任务列表。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-clarify.title: spec-product-clarify
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-clarify.description: Use when 在 sdlc-dev 的 spec 分支上，需求模糊/范围不稳/约束不清，且出现上下文漂移、脑补、一次问多题、或被要求跳过 FEATURE_DIR/raw 门禁。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-clarify.descriptionEn: Use when 在 sdlc-dev 的 spec 分支上，需求模糊/范围不稳/约束不清，且出现上下文漂移、脑补、一次问多题、或被要求跳过 FEATURE_DIR/raw 门禁。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-clarify.descriptionCn: 当在 sdlc-dev 的规范分支上，要求模糊/范围不稳定/约束不清楚，并且发生上下文漂移、假设、同时出现多个问题或被要求跳过 FEATURE_DIR/raw 门时使用。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-demo.title: spec-product-demo
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-demo.description: Use when 需要在 sdlc-dev 的产品需求 Spec 流程执行 R4（基于 requirements/prototype.md 生成可交互 Demo 工程），并需要避免跳过 spec-context、在缺少 prototype.md 或缺少可运行 Demo 工程根目录时仍继续、或自创页面/目录导致不可追溯与无法回流闭环。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-demo.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在 sdlc-dev 的产品需求 Spec 流程执行 R4（基于 requirements/prototype.md 生成可交互 Demo 工程），并需要避免跳过 spec-context、在缺少 prototype.md 或缺少可运行 Demo 工程根目录时仍继续、或自创页面/目录导致不可追溯与无法回流闭环。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-demo.descriptionCn: 当您需要在 sdlc-dev 产品需求 Spec 流程中执行 R4（根据requirements/prototype.md 生成交互式演示项目）时使用，并且必须避免跳过规范上下文、在缺少prototype.md 或不存在可运行的演示项目根目录时继续执行，或者创建使流程无法追踪且无法关闭反馈循环的临时页面/目录。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-prd.title: spec-product-prd
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-prd.description: Use when 需要在 sdlc-dev 的产品需求 Spec 流程执行 R2，将 requirements/solution.md 转写为可交付、可验收、可测试的 requirements/prd.md，且需要避免猜路径、在缺少 solution.md 时仍继续生成、或用“待确认问题/Open Questions”替代验证清单。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-prd.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在 sdlc-dev 的产品需求 Spec 流程执行 R2，将 requirements/solution.md 转写为可交付、可验收、可测试的 requirements/prd.md，且需要避免猜路径、在缺少 solution.md 时仍继续生成、或用“待确认问题/Open Questions”替代验证清单。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-prd.descriptionCn: 当R2需要在sdlc-dev的产品需求Spec流程中执行时使用，将requirements/solution.md重写为可交付、可验证、可测试的requirements/prd.md，并且必须避免猜测路径，在solution.md缺失时继续生成，或用“待确认/开放问题”替换验证清单。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-prototy.title: spec-product-prototype
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-prototy.description: Use when 需要在 sdlc-dev 的产品需求 Spec 流程执行 R3（原型生成），基于 requirements/prd.md 产出 requirements/prototype.md（任务流+页面结构+ASCII线框+AC映射+走查脚本），并避免缺少上下文/缺少 PRD 仍继续生成、用 Open Questions 代替验证清单、或用非 ASCII 方式导致原型不可追溯与不可评审。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-prototy.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在 sdlc-dev 的产品需求 Spec 流程执行 R3（原型生成），基于 requirements/prd.md 产出 requirements/prototype.md（任务流+页面结构+ASCII线框+AC映射+走查脚本），并避免缺少上下文/缺少 PRD 仍继续生成、用 Open Questions 代替验证清单、或用非 ASCII 方式导致原型不可追溯与不可评审。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-product-prototy.descriptionCn: 当sdlc-dev中的产品需求Spec流程需要根据requirements/prd.md执行R3（原型生成）以生成requirements/prototype.md（任务流程+页面结构+ASCII线框+AC映射+走查脚本）时使用，并避免在没有上下文/缺少PRD的情况下继续生成，用开放问题替换验证清单，或使用使原型无法追踪和无法审查的非ASCII格式。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-receiving-code-.title: spec-receiving-code-review
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-receiving-code-.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-receiving-code-.descriptionEn: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-receiving-code-.descriptionCn: 在收到代码审查反馈时、在实施建议之前使用，特别是当反馈似乎不清楚或技术上有问题时 - 需要技术严谨和验证，而不是执行协议或盲目实施

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-requesting-code.title: spec-requesting-code-review
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-requesting-code.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-requesting-code.descriptionEn: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-requesting-code.descriptionCn: 在完成任务、实现主要功能时或合并之前使用，以验证工作是否满足要求

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test.title: spec-test
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test.description: Use when 需要在 Spec Pack 的 verification 阶段生成/更新测试计划、用例、套件或测试报告，并要求严格门禁、可追溯落盘与不越权路由。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在 Spec Pack 的 verification 阶段生成/更新测试计划、用例、套件或测试报告，并要求严格门禁、可追溯落盘与不越权路由。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test.descriptionCn: 当需要在规格包验证阶段生成/更新测试计划、案例、套件或报告时使用，具有严格的门控、完全可追溯性且无未经授权的路由。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-bug.title: spec-test-bug
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-bug.description: Use when 需要在 Spec Pack 的 verification 阶段创建“可直接粘贴到外部缺陷系统”的缺陷报告（不在 Spec Pack 内落盘 bug 文件），并将缺陷引用回写到 `{FEATURE_DIR}/verification/report-*.md`。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-bug.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在 Spec Pack 的 verification 阶段创建“可直接粘贴到外部缺陷系统”的缺陷报告（不在 Spec Pack 内落盘 bug 文件），并将缺陷引用回写到 `{FEATURE_DIR}/verification/report-*.md`。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-bug.descriptionCn: 当您需要创建可在规范包验证阶段直接粘贴到外部缺陷跟踪系统中的错误报告（无需在规范包内创建错误文件）并将错误引用写回到“{FEATURE_DIR}/verification/report-*.md”时使用。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-execute.title: spec-test-execute
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-execute.description: Use when 需要在 Spec Pack 的 verification 阶段产出 `{FEATURE_DIR}/verification/report-{date}-{version}.md`（测试报告），给出可交付结论并可追溯到用例与缺陷引用。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-execute.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在 Spec Pack 的 verification 阶段产出 `{FEATURE_DIR}/verification/report-{date}-{version}.md`（测试报告），给出可交付结论并可追溯到用例与缺陷引用。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-execute.descriptionCn: 在规范包的验证阶段需要生成“{FEATURE_DIR}/verification/report-{date}-{version}.md”（测试报告）时使用，提供可追溯到测试用例和缺陷参考的可交付结论。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-plan.title: spec-test-plan
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-plan.description: Use when 需要在 Spec Pack 的 verification 阶段生成或更新 `{FEATURE_DIR}/verification/test-plan.md`（测试计划），并要求严格门禁与可追溯。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-plan.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在 Spec Pack 的 verification 阶段生成或更新 `{FEATURE_DIR}/verification/test-plan.md`（测试计划），并要求严格门禁与可追溯。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-plan.descriptionCn: 当您需要在规范包的验证阶段生成或更新“{FEATURE_DIR}/verification/test-plan.md”（测试计划）时使用，并需要严格的控制和可追溯性。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-suites.title: spec-test-suites
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-suites.description: Use when 需要在 Spec Pack 的 verification 阶段生成或更新 `{FEATURE_DIR}/verification/suites.md`（测试套件），把用例组织成可执行集合并定义阻断规则与执行顺序。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-suites.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在 Spec Pack 的 verification 阶段生成或更新 `{FEATURE_DIR}/verification/suites.md`（测试套件），把用例组织成可执行集合并定义阻断规则与执行顺序。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-suites.descriptionCn: 当您需要在规范包验证阶段生成或更新“{FEATURE_DIR}/verification/suites.md”（测试套件）、将测试用例组织成可执行集并定义阻止规则和执行顺序时使用。

zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-usecase.title: spec-test-usecase
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-usecase.description: Use when 需要在 Spec Pack 的 verification 阶段生成或更新 `{FEATURE_DIR}/verification/usecase.md`（测试用例），并要求 AC 可追溯与结构可生成自动化脚本。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-usecase.descriptionEn: Use when 需要在 Spec Pack 的 verification 阶段生成或更新 `{FEATURE_DIR}/verification/usecase.md`（测试用例），并要求 AC 可追溯与结构可生成自动化脚本。
zixun-github/aisdlc/spec-test-usecase.descriptionCn: 当您需要在规范包的验证阶段生成或更新“{FEATURE_DIR}/verification/usecase.md”（测试用例）时使用，以确保 AC 可追溯性并启用从结构自动生成脚本。

zixun-github/aisdlc/subagent-driven-deve.title: subagent-driven-development
zixun-github/aisdlc/subagent-driven-deve.description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session

ziyang-oyxy/deep-research-skill/deep-res.title: deep-research
ziyang-oyxy/deep-research-skill/deep-res.description: Conducts enterprise-grade research with multi-source synthesis, citation tracking, contract gating, and resumable markdown-first report assembly. The local helper defaults to skeleton-only initialization: it mainly creates phase artifacts, state files, and a report skeleton rather than automatically finishing retrieval, writing, and artifact backfill. Triggers on "deep research", "comprehensive analysis", "research report", "compare X vs Y", "analyze trends", or "state of the art". Not for simple lookups, debugging, or questions answerable with 1-2 searches.

新手写作双模式 Skill。面向学员和用户，不要求先有个人 profile、长期记忆沉淀或代表作。
当用户想“先写出一篇很强的文章”，但自己没有足够素材、经历或风格资产时，优先使用这个 skill。

zlipeng/agent-skills/memory-keeper.description:
Save and load durable knowledge — project facts, conversation context, or user requirements/preferences — in a per-project memory store under `~/.agents/memories/`.
TRIGGER (save) when: the user invokes this skill to persist something; says "save this to memory", "remember this", "记一下", "保存记忆", "记住这个", "把这个存到记忆里"; states a durable preference, decision, or constraint worth carrying across sessions; or asks to summarize the project / context for later.
TRIGGER (load) when: the user invokes this skill to recall; says "load project memory", "read my memories", "what do you remember", "读取该项目记忆", "加载记忆", "回忆一下这个项目"; or starts work on a project and wants prior context restored.
DO NOT TRIGGER when: the fact only matters to the current turn, is already recorded in the repo (code, README, git history), or the user is just asking a question without wanting anything persisted or recalled.

在“~/.agents/memories/”下的每个项目内存存储中保存和加载持久知识——项目事实、对话上下文或用户需求/偏好。
触发（保存）时间：用户调用此技能来保存某些内容；说“把这个保存到记忆中”，“记住这个”，“记一下”，“保存记忆”，“记住这个”，“把这个存到记忆里”；陈述值得跨会议进行的持久偏好、决定或约束；或者要求总结项目/背景以供稍后使用。

zoonk/zoonk/cache-components.title: cache-components
zoonk/zoonk/cache-components.description:
Expert guidance for Next.js Cache Components and Partial Prerendering (PPR).

**PROACTIVE ACTIVATION**: Use this skill automatically when working in Next.js projects that have `cacheComponents: true` in their next.config.ts/next.config.js. When this config is detected, proactively apply Cache Components patterns and best practices to all React Server Component implementations.

**DETECTION**: At the start of a session in a Next.js project, check for `cacheComponents: true` in next.config. If enabled, this skill's patterns should guide all component authoring, data fetching, and caching decisions.

**USE CASES**: Implementing 'use cache' directive, configuring cache lifetimes with cacheLife(), tagging cached data with cacheTag(), invalidating caches with updateTag()/revalidateTag(), optimizing static vs dynamic content boundaries, debugging cache issues, and reviewing Cache Component implementations.
zoonk/zoonk/cache-components.descriptionEn:
Expert guidance for Next.js Cache Components and Partial Prerendering (PPR).

When this config is detected, proactively apply Cache Components patterns and best practices to all React Server Component implementations.

**USE CASES**: Implementing 'use cache' directive, configuring cache lifetimes with cacheLife(), tagging cached data with cacheTag(), invalidating caches with updateTag()/revalidateTag(), optimizing static vs dynamic content boundaries, debugging cache issues, and reviewing Cache Component implementations.
zoonk/zoonk/cache-components.descriptionCn:
Next.js 缓存组件和部分预渲染 (PPR) 的专家指南。

**主动激活**：在 next.js 项目中工作时，在 next.config.ts/next.config.js 中包含 `cacheComponents: true` 时，自动使用此技能。当检测到此配置时，主动将缓存组件模式和最佳实践应用于所有 React 服务器组件实现。

**检测**：在 Next.js 项目中的会话开始时，检查 next.config 中的“cacheComponents: true”。如果启用，该技能的模式应指导所有组件创作、数据获取和缓存决策。

**用例**：实现“使用缓存”指令、使用cacheLife()配置缓存生命周期、使用cacheTag()标记缓存数据、使用updateTag()/revalidateTag()使缓存无效、优化静态与动态内容边界、调试缓存问题以及检查缓存组件实现。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/agent-observability.title: agent-observability
zpankz/mcp-skillset/agent-observability.description:
Real-time observability dashboard for multi-agent Claude Code sessions.

Visualize agent interactions, tool usage, and session flows in real-time through a web dashboard. Track multiple agents running in parallel with swim lane visualization, event filtering, and live charts.

**Key Features:**
- 🔴 Real-time event streaming via WebSocket
- 📊 Agent swim lanes showing parallel execution
- 🔍 Event filtering by agent, session, event type
- 📈 Live charts for tool usage patterns
- 💾 Filesystem-based (no database required)

**Inspired by [@indydevdan](https://github.com/indydevdan)**'s work on multi-agent observability.

**Our approach:** Filesystem + in-memory streaming vs. indydevdan's SQLite database approach.

多代理 Claude Code 会话的实时可观察性仪表板。

通过 Web 仪表板实时可视化代理交互、工具使用情况和会话流。通过泳道可视化、事件过滤和实时图表跟踪并行运行的多个代理。

**主要特点：**
- 🔴 通过 WebSocket 进行实时事件流
- 📊 代理泳道显示并行执行

multi-step workflows with review cycles. Orchestrates parallel research agents, 
multi-lens assessment, and structured knowledge codification into searchable 
documentation with YAML frontmatter. Implements λο.τ → λ(ο,Κ).τ where Κ is 
accumulated knowledge that compounds interest-like over time.

zpankz/mcp-skillset/critique.title: critique

zpankz/mcp-skillset/critique.descriptionCn: 多视角辩证推理与交叉评价综合。产生平行的评价镜头（结构性、证据性、范围性、对抗性、实用性），批评论文并批评彼此的批评，在递归聚合之前产生 N 平方评价矩阵。触发 /critique、/dialectic、/crosseval、要求进行彻底分析、压力测试论证或发现弱点。实施通过交错多域评估和收敛综合增强的黑格尔细化。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/dependency-health.title: Dependency Health
zpankz/mcp-skillset/dependency-health.description: Security-first dependency management methodology with batch remediation, policy-driven compliance, and automated enforcement. Use when security vulnerabilities exist in dependencies, dependency freshness low (outdated packages), license compliance needed, or systematic dependency management lacking. Provides security-first prioritization (critical vulnerabilities immediately, high within week, medium within month), batch remediation strategy (group compatible updates, test together, single PR), policy-driven compliance framework (security policies, freshness policies, license policies), and automation tools for vulnerability scanning, update detection, and compliance checking. Validated in meta-cc with 6x speedup (9 hours manual to 1.5 hours systematic), 3 iterations, 88% transferability across package managers (concepts universal, tools vary by ecosystem).
zpankz/mcp-skillset/dependency-health.descriptionEn: Security-first dependency management methodology with batch remediation, policy-driven compliance, and automated enforcement. Use when security vulnerabilities exist in dependencies, dependency freshness low (outdated packages), license compliance needed, or systematic dependency management lacking. Provides security-first prioritization (critical vulnerabilities immediately, high within week, medium within month), batch remediation strategy (group compatible updates, test together, single PR), policy-driven compliance framework (security policies, freshness policies, license policies), and automation tools for vulnerability scanning, update detection, and compliance checking. Validated in meta-cc with 6x speedup (9 hours manual to 1.5 hours systematic), 3 iterations, 88% transferability across package managers (concepts universal, tools vary by ecosystem).
zpankz/mcp-skillset/dependency-health.descriptionCn: 安全第一的依赖管理方法，具有批量修复、策略驱动的合规性和自动执行功能。当依赖项中存在安全漏洞、依赖项新鲜度低（过时的软件包）、需要许可证合规性或缺乏系统依赖项管理时使用。提供安全第一的优先级（紧急漏洞、周内高、月内中）、批量修复策略（分组兼容更新、一起测试、单个 PR）、策略驱动的合规框架（安全策略、新鲜度策略、许可证策略）以及用于漏洞扫描、更新检测和合规性检查的自动化工具。在 meta-cc 中进行了验证，加速速度提高了 6 倍（手动 9 小时到系统化 1.5 小时）、3 次迭代、跨包管理器的可迁移性达到 88%（概念通用，工具因生态系统而异）。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/dialectical.title: dialectical
zpankz/mcp-skillset/dialectical.description: Compose intellectually sophisticated persuasive essays using tripartite dialectical structure (establish-critique-synthesize), paradox accumulation, conversational register calibration, and strategic humility. Supports three atomic writing primitives (AGONAL α, MAIEUTIC β, APOPHATIC γ) with hypersoft plithogenic composition, plus legacy style modes and hybrid combinations. Triggers on requests for persuasive writing to mixed/skeptical audiences, defending counterintuitive claims, Socratic pedagogical dialogue, editorial first-person essays, or writing that must balance accessibility with depth. Implements recursive thematic anchoring, forced dilemma construction, and transformed return closure. Use when linear argumentation is insufficient and accumulated tension resolves through synthesis.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/dialectical.descriptionEn: Compose intellectually sophisticated persuasive essays using tripartite dialectical structure (establish-critique-synthesize), paradox accumulation, conversational register calibration, and strategic humility. Supports three atomic writing primitives (AGONAL α, MAIEUTIC β, APOPHATIC γ) with hypersoft plithogenic composition, plus legacy style modes and hybrid combinations. Triggers on requests for persuasive writing to mixed/skeptical audiences, defending counterintuitive claims, Socratic pedagogical dialogue, editorial first-person essays, or writing that must balance accessibility with depth. Implements recursive thematic anchoring, forced dilemma construction, and transformed return closure. Use when linear argumentation is insufficient and accumulated tension resolves through synthesis.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/dialectical.descriptionCn: 使用三重辩证结构（建立-批评-综合）、悖论积累、对话语域校准和策略谦逊来撰写智力复杂的有说服力的文章。支持三种原子写入原语（AGONAL α、MAIEUTIC β、APOPHATIC γ），具有超软复生组合，以及遗留样式模式和混合组合。触发对混合/持怀疑态度的受众进行有说服力的写作、捍卫反直觉的主张、苏格拉底式教学对话、社论第一人称文章或必须平衡可访问性与深度的写作的请求。实现递归主题锚定、强制困境构建和变换返回闭包。当线性论证不充分并且积累的张力通过综合解决时使用。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/error-recovery.title: Error Recovery
zpankz/mcp-skillset/error-recovery.description: Comprehensive error handling methodology with 13-category taxonomy, diagnostic workflows, recovery patterns, and prevention guidelines. Use when error rate >5%, MTTD/MTTR too high, errors recurring, need systematic error prevention, or building error handling infrastructure. Provides error taxonomy (file operations, API calls, data validation, resource management, concurrency, configuration, dependency, network, parsing, state management, authentication, timeout, edge cases - 95.4% coverage), 8 diagnostic workflows, 5 recovery patterns, 8 prevention guidelines, 3 automation tools (file path validation, read-before-write check, file size validation - 23.7% error prevention). Validated with 1,336 historical errors, 85-90% transferability across languages/platforms, 0.79 confidence retrospective validation.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/error-recovery.descriptionEn: Comprehensive error handling methodology with 13-category taxonomy, diagnostic workflows, recovery patterns, and prevention guidelines. Use when error rate >5%, MTTD/MTTR too high, errors recurring, need systematic error prevention, or building error handling infrastructure. Provides error taxonomy (file operations, API calls, data validation, resource management, concurrency, configuration, dependency, network, parsing, state management, authentication, timeout, edge cases - 95.4% coverage), 8 diagnostic workflows, 5 recovery patterns, 8 prevention guidelines, 3 automation tools (file path validation, read-before-write check, file size validation - 23.7% error prevention). Validated with 1,336 historical errors, 85-90% transferability across languages/platforms, 0.79 confidence retrospective validation.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/error-recovery.descriptionCn: 全面的错误处理方法，包含 13 类分类法、诊断工作流程、恢复模式和预防指南。当错误率 >5%、MTTD/MTTR 过高、错误重复出现、需要系统性错误预防或构建错误处理基础设施时使用。提供错误分类（文件操作、API 调用、数据验证、资源管理、并发、配置、依赖、网络、解析、状态管理、身份验证、超时、边缘情况 - 95.4% 覆盖率）、8 个诊断工作流程、5 个恢复模式、8 个预防指南、3 个自动化工具（文件路径验证、写前读取检查、文件大小验证 - 23.7% 错误预防）。经过 1,336 个历史错误的验证，跨语言/平台的可转移性为 85-90%，回顾性验证的置信度为 0.79。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/goals.title: goals
zpankz/mcp-skillset/goals.description: Optimize prompts via process goals (controllable behavioral instructions) rather than outcome goals (sparse end-result demands). Grounded in sports psychology meta-analysis showing process goals (d=1.36) vastly outperform outcome goals (d=0.09). Use when designing prompts, optimizing LLM steering, implementing CoT/decomposition patterns, or building automatic prompt optimization pipelines. Instantiates surrogate loss paradigm for discrete prompt space.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/goals.descriptionEn: Optimize prompts via process goals (controllable behavioral instructions) rather than outcome goals (sparse end-result demands). zpankz/mcp-skillset/goals.descriptionCn: 通过过程目标（可控的行为指令）而不是结果目标（稀疏的最终结果需求）来优化提示。基于运动心理学荟萃分析，显示过程目标 (d=1.36) 远远优于结果目标 (d=0.09)。在设计提示、优化 LLM 指导、实施 CoT/分解模式或构建自动提示优化管道时使用。实例化离散提示空间的替代损失范例。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/graph.title: graph

zpankz/mcp-skillset/hkgb.title: hkgb
zpankz/mcp-skillset/hkgb.description: This skill should be used when building hybrid Knowledge Graphs that integrate structured data (CSV, databases) with automatically extracted entities from unstructured documents (PDFs, text). zpankz/mcp-skillset/hkgb.descriptionCn: 在构建将结构化数据（CSV、数据库）与从非结构化文档（PDF、文本）中自动提取的实体集成的混合知识图时，应该使用此技能。该模式在域图和词法图之间建立了可靠的连接键，从而支持 GraphRAG、通过元数据丰富进行文档摄取，以及使用 neo4j-graphrag SimpleKGPipeline 从异构源构建知识图。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/maker-framework.title: maker-framework

zpankz/mcp-skillset/mega.title: mega

Use when (1) simple graphs insufficient (η<2), (2) multi-scale reasoning required, (3) uncertainty is structured not stochastic, (4) knowledge must self-refactor. Pareto-governed: complexity added only when simpler structures fail validation.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/mega.descriptionEn: Maximally Endowed Graph Architecture — λ-calculus over bounded n-SuperHyperGraphs with grounded uncertainty, conditional self-duality, and autopoietic refinement. Use when (1) simple graphs insufficient (η<2), (2) multi-scale reasoning required, (3) uncertainty is structured not stochastic, (4) knowledge must self-refactor. Pareto-governed: complexity added only when simpler structures fail validation.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/mega.descriptionCn: 最大赋予图架构 - 有界 n-SuperHyperGraph 上的 λ 演算，具有接地不确定性、条件自对偶性和自创生细化。当（1）简单图不足（η<2），（2）需要多尺度推理，（3）不确定性是结构化的而不是随机的，（4）知识必须自我重构时使用。帕累托支配：仅当较简单的结构无法验证时才会增加复杂性。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/methodology-bootstra.title: Methodology Bootstrapping
zpankz/mcp-skillset/methodology-bootstra.description: Apply Bootstrapped AI Methodology Engineering (BAIME) to develop project-specific methodologies through systematic Observe-Codify-Automate cycles with dual-layer value functions (instance quality + methodology quality). Use when creating testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, error handling patterns, observability systems, or any reusable development methodology. Provides structured framework with convergence criteria, agent coordination, and empirical validation. Validated in 8 experiments with 100% success rate, 4.9 avg iterations, 10-50x speedup vs ad-hoc. Works for testing, CI/CD, error recovery, dependency management, documentation systems, knowledge transfer, technical debt, cross-cutting concerns.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/methodology-bootstra.descriptionEn: Apply Bootstrapped AI Methodology Engineering (BAIME) to develop project-specific methodologies through systematic Observe-Codify-Automate cycles with dual-layer value functions (instance quality + methodology quality). Use when creating testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, error handling patterns, observability systems, or any reusable development methodology. Provides structured framework with convergence criteria, agent coordination, and empirical validation. Validated in 8 experiments with 100% success rate, 4.9 avg iterations, 10-50x speedup vs ad-hoc. zpankz/mcp-skillset/methodology-bootstra.descriptionCn: 应用引导人工智能方法论工程 (BAIME)，通过具有双层价值函数（实例质量 + 方法论质量）的系统性观察-编码-自动化循环来开发特定于项目的方法论。在创建测试策略、CI/CD 管道、错误处理模式、可观察性系统或任何可重用开发方法时使用。提供具有收敛标准、代理协调和经验验证的结构化框架。经过 8 次实验验证，成功率 100%，平均迭代次数 4.9，与 ad-hoc 相比加速 10-50 倍。适用于测试、CI/CD、错误恢复、依赖管理、文档系统、知识转移、技术债务、横切关注点。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/multi-agent-coordina.title: multi-agent-coordination
zpankz/mcp-skillset/multi-agent-coordina.description: Automatically invoked when peer agents are detected in the same project. Establishes coordination protocols, file reservations, and message-based collaboration. Triggers on SessionStart when other agents exist in the project.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/multi-agent-coordina.descriptionEn: Automatically invoked when peer agents are detected in the same project. Establishes coordination protocols, file reservations, and message-based collaboration. Triggers on SessionStart when other agents exist in the project.

zpankz/mcp-skillset/multi-agent-patterns.title: multi-agent-patterns
zpankz/mcp-skillset/multi-agent-patterns.description: Design multi-agent architectures for complex tasks. Use when single-agent context limits are exceeded, when tasks decompose naturally into subtasks, or when specializing agents improves quality.

zpankz/mcp-skillset/multi-agent-patterns.descriptionCn: 为复杂任务设计多代理架构。当超出单代理上下文限制、任务自然分解为子任务或专门代理提高质量时使用。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/network-meta-analysi.title: network-meta-analysis-appraisal
zpankz/mcp-skillset/network-meta-analysi.description: Systematically appraise network meta-analysis papers using integrated 200-point checklist (PRISMA-NMA, NICE DSU TSD 7, ISPOR-AMCP-NPC, CINeMA) with triple-validation methodology, automated PDF extraction, semantic evidence matching, and concordance analysis. Use when evaluating NMA quality for peer review, guideline development, HTA, or reimbursement decisions.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/network-meta-analysi.descriptionEn: Systematically appraise network meta-analysis papers using integrated 200-point checklist (PRISMA-NMA, NICE DSU TSD 7, ISPOR-AMCP-NPC, CINeMA) with triple-validation methodology, automated PDF extraction, semantic evidence matching, and concordance analysis. Use when evaluating NMA quality for peer review, guideline development, HTA, or reimbursement decisions.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/network-meta-analysi.descriptionCn: 使用集成的 200 点检查表（PRISMA-NMA、NICE DSU TSD 7、ISPOR-AMCP-NPC、CINeMA）以及三重验证方法、自动 PDF 提取、语义证据匹配和一致性分析来系统评估网络荟萃分析论文。在评估 NMA 质量以进行同行评审、指南制定、HTA 或报销决策时使用。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/non-linear.title: non-linear
zpankz/mcp-skillset/non-linear.description: Uncertainty-aware non-linear reasoning system with recursive subagent orchestration. Triggers for complex reasoning, research, multi-domain synthesis, or when explicit commands `/nlr`, `/reason`, `/think-deep` are used. Integrates think skill (reasoning), agent-core skill (acting), and MCP tools (infranodus, exa, scholar-gateway) in recursive think→act→observe loops. Uses coding sandbox for execution validation and maintains deliberate noisiness via NoisyGraph scaffold. Supports `/compact` mode for abbreviated outputs and `/semantic` mode for rich exploration.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/non-linear.descriptionEn: Uncertainty-aware non-linear reasoning system with recursive subagent orchestration. Triggers for complex reasoning, research, multi-domain synthesis, or when explicit commands `/nlr`, `/reason`, `/think-deep` are used. Integrates think skill (reasoning), agent-core skill (acting), and MCP tools (infranodus, exa, scholar-gateway) in recursive think→act→observe loops. Uses coding sandbox for execution validation and maintains deliberate noisiness via NoisyGraph scaffold. Supports `/compact` mode for abbreviated outputs and `/semantic` mode for rich exploration.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/non-linear.descriptionCn: 具有递归子代理编排的不确定性感知非线性推理系统。复杂推理、研究、多领域综合或使用显式命令“/nlr”、“/reason”、“/think-deep”时的触发器。在递归思考→行动→观察循环中集成思考技能（推理）、主体核心技能（表演）和 MCP 工具（infranodus、exa、学者网关）。使用编码沙箱进行执行验证，并通过 NoisyGraph 脚手架保持故意的噪音。支持用于缩写输出的“/compact”模式和用于丰富探索的“/semantic”模式。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/observability-instru.title: Observability Instrumentation
zpankz/mcp-skillset/observability-instru.description: Comprehensive observability methodology implementing three pillars (logs, metrics, traces) with structured logging using Go slog, Prometheus-style metrics, and distributed tracing patterns. Use when adding observability from scratch, logs unstructured or inadequate, no metrics collection, debugging production issues difficult, or need performance monitoring. Provides structured logging patterns (contextual logging, log levels DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR, request ID propagation), metrics instrumentation (counter/gauge/histogram patterns, Prometheus exposition), tracing setup (span creation, context propagation, sampling strategies), and Go slog best practices (JSON formatting, attribute management, handler configuration). Validated in meta-cc with 23-46x speedup vs ad-hoc logging, 90-95% transferability across languages (slog specific to Go but patterns universal).
zpankz/mcp-skillset/observability-instru.descriptionEn: Comprehensive observability methodology implementing three pillars (logs, metrics, traces) with structured logging using Go slog, Prometheus-style metrics, and distributed tracing patterns. Use when adding observability from scratch, logs unstructured or inadequate, no metrics collection, debugging production issues difficult, or need performance monitoring. Provides structured logging patterns (contextual logging, log levels DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR, request ID propagation), metrics instrumentation (counter/gauge/histogram patterns, Prometheus exposition), tracing setup (span creation, context propagation, sampling strategies), and Go slog best practices (JSON formatting, attribute management, handler configuration). Validated in meta-cc with 23-46x speedup vs ad-hoc logging, 90-95% transferability across languages (slog specific to Go but patterns universal).
zpankz/mcp-skillset/observability-instru.descriptionCn: 全面的可观察性方法通过使用 Go slog、Prometheus 式指标和分布式跟踪模式的结构化日志记录实现三大支柱（日志、指标、跟踪）。当从头开始添加可观察性、日志非结构化或不充分、没有指标收集、调试生产问题困难或需要性能监控时使用。提供结构化日志记录模式（上下文日志记录、日志级别 DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR、请求 ID 传播）、指标检测（计数器/仪表/直方图模式、Prometheus 展示）、跟踪设置（跨度创建、上下文传播、采样策略）和 Go slog 最佳实践（JSON 格式、属性管理、处理程序配置）。在 meta-cc 中进行了验证，与临时日志记录相比，速度提高了 23-46 倍，跨语言的可转移性为 90-95%（slog 特定于 Go，但模式是通用的）。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/obsidian.title: obsidian

zpankz/mcp-skillset/obsidian-bases.descriptionEn: Create and edit Obsidian Bases (.base files) with views, filters, formulas, and summaries. zpankz/mcp-skillset/obsidian-batch.title: obsidian-batch

zpankz/mcp-skillset/obsidian-batch.descriptionEn: Batch processing for Obsidian vaults: bulk tag normalization, wikilink extraction/fixing, frontmatter edits, vault analysis, and migration workflows. zpankz/mcp-skillset/rapid-convergence.title: Rapid Convergence
zpankz/mcp-skillset/rapid-convergence.description: Achieve 3-4 iteration methodology convergence (vs standard 5-7) when clear baseline metrics exist, domain scope is focused, and direct validation is possible. Use when you have V_meta baseline ≥0.40, quantifiable success criteria, retrospective validation data, and generic agents are sufficient. Enables 40-60% time reduction (10-15 hours vs 20-30 hours) without sacrificing quality. Prediction model helps estimate iteration count during experiment planning. Validated in error recovery (3 iterations, 10 hours, V_instance=0.83, V_meta=0.85).

zpankz/mcp-skillset/rapid-convergence.descriptionCn: 当存在明确的基线指标、关注领域范围并且可以直接验证时，实现 3-4 次迭代方法收敛（相对于标准 5-7 次）。当 V_meta 基线≥0.40、可量化的成功标准、回顾性验证数据和通用药物就足够时使用。在不牺牲质量的情况下，可缩短 40-60% 的时间（10-15 小时 vs 20-30 小时）。预测模型有助于估计实验计划期间的迭代次数。在错误恢复中进行验证（3次迭代，10小时，V_instance=0.83，V_meta=0.85）。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/retrospective-valida.title: Retrospective Validation

Validated in error recovery (1,336 errors, 23.7% prevention, 0.79 confidence).

zpankz/mcp-skillset/rpp.title: rpp
zpankz/mcp-skillset/rpp.description:
Generates hierarchical knowledge graphs via Recursive Pareto Principle for optimised 
schema construction. Produces four-level structures (L0 meta-graph through L3 detail-graph) 
where each level contains 80% fewer nodes while grounding 80% of its derivative, achieving 
51% coverage from 0.8% of nodes via Pareto³ compression. Use when creating domain ontologies 
or knowledge architectures requiring: (1) Atomic first principles with emergent composites, 
(2) Pareto-optimised information density, (3) Small-world topology with validated node 
ratios (L1:L2 2-3:1), or (4) Bidirectional construction. Integrates with graph (η≥4 
validation), abduct (refactoring), mega (SuperHyperGraphs), infranodus (gap detection). 
Triggers: 'schema generation', 'ontology creation', 'Pareto hierarchy', 'recursive graph', 
'first principles decomposition'.

Generates hierarchical knowledge graphs via Recursive Pareto Principle for optimised 
schema construction. Produces four-level structures (L0 meta-graph through L3 detail-graph) 
where each level contains 80% fewer nodes while grounding 80% of its derivative, achieving 
51% coverage from 0.8% of nodes via Pareto³ compression. Use when creating domain ontologies 
or knowledge architectures requiring: (1) Atomic first principles with emergent composites, 
(2) Pareto-optimised information density, (3) Small-world topology with validated node 
ratios (L1:L2 2-3:1), or (4) Bidirectional construction. Integrates with graph (η≥4 
validation), abduct (refactoring), mega (SuperHyperGraphs), infranodus (gap detection). 
Triggers: 'schema generation', 'ontology creation', 'Pareto hierarchy', 'recursive graph', 
'first principles decomposition'.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/rpp.descriptionCn:
通过递归帕累托原理生成分层知识图以进行优化 
架构构建。生成四层结构（L0 元图到 L3 细节图） 
其中每个级别包含的节点数减少 80%，同时将其导数的 80% 接地，实现 
通过帕累托压缩，0.8% 的节点覆盖 51%。创建领域本体时使用 
或知识架构要求：（1）具有紧急组合的原子第一原理， 
(2) 帕累托优化信息密度，(3) 具有经过验证的节点的小世界拓扑 
比率（L1:L2 2-3:1），或 (4) 双向结构。与图积分（η≥4 
验证）、abduct（重构）、mega（SuperHyperGraphs）、infranodus（间隙检测）。 
触发器：“模式生成”、“本体创建”、“帕累托层次结构”、“递归图”、 
“第一原理分解”。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/technical-debt-manag.title: Technical Debt Management
zpankz/mcp-skillset/technical-debt-manag.description: Systematic technical debt quantification and management using SQALE methodology with value-effort prioritization, phased paydown roadmaps, and prevention strategies. Use when technical debt unmeasured or subjective, need objective prioritization, planning refactoring work, establishing debt prevention practices, or tracking debt trends over time. Provides 6 methodology components (measurement with SQALE index, categorization with code smell taxonomy, prioritization with value-effort matrix, phased paydown roadmap, trend tracking system, prevention guidelines), 3 patterns (SQALE-based quantification, code smell taxonomy mapping, value-effort prioritization), 3 principles (high-value low-effort first, SQALE provides objective baseline, complexity drives maintainability debt). Validated with 4.5x speedup vs manual approach, 85% transferability across languages (Go, Python, JavaScript, Java, Rust), SQALE industry-standard methodology.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/technical-debt-manag.descriptionEn: Systematic technical debt quantification and management using SQALE methodology with value-effort prioritization, phased paydown roadmaps, and prevention strategies. Provides 6 methodology components (measurement with SQALE index, categorization with code smell taxonomy, prioritization with value-effort matrix, phased paydown roadmap, trend tracking system, prevention guidelines), 3 patterns (SQALE-based quantification, code smell taxonomy mapping, value-effort prioritization), 3 principles (high-value low-effort first, SQALE provides objective baseline, complexity drives maintainability debt). Validated with 4.5x speedup vs manual approach, 85% transferability across languages (Go, Python, JavaScript, Java, Rust), SQALE industry-standard methodology.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/technical-debt-manag.descriptionCn: 使用 SQALE 方法进行系统性技术债务量化和管理，并确定价值努力优先级、分阶段还款路线图和预防策略。当技术债务无法衡量或主观、需要客观优先级、规划重构工作、建立债务预防实践或跟踪一段时间内的债务趋势时使用。提供 6 个方法组件（使用 SQALE 指数进行测量、使用代码异味分类法进行分类、使用价值-努力矩阵进行优先级排序、分阶段支付路线图、趋势跟踪系统、预防指南）、3 个模式（基于 SQALE 的量化、代码异味分类映射、价值-努力优先级排序）、3 个原则（高价值低努力优先、SQALE 提供客观基线、复杂性驱动可维护性债务）。经过验证，与手动方法相比，速度提高了 4.5 倍，跨语言（Go、Python、JavaScript、Java、Rust）的可移植性达到 85%，SQALE 行业标准方法。

ztaihang/agent-skills/hyperframes-shorts.title: hyperframes-shorts
ztaihang/agent-skills/hyperframes-shorts.description: HyperFrames 中文短视频视觉与版式预处理规范（抖音/小红书竖屏可读）。适用于任意镜头数量的中文解说视频。必须先读本 Skill，再读 hyperframes、hyperframes-cli、gsap；写 HTML 前必须读 design-taste-frontend（taste-skill）、templates/anti-slop-motion-scheme.md、templates/hyperframes-zh-checklist.md、css-animations、design-motion-principles、web-typography 与 templates/visual-style-guide.md，每项目须产出 design.md（含 Motion Plan）并轮换视觉风格，禁止套同一模板。硬性版式：底部字幕永远单行、页面文字不得重叠、中文须本地 fonts/ + @font-face（禁 PingFang/微软雅黑/Google Fonts）、禁止 AI 风 emoji/表情包式插图；动效：L0 `#root` 静态背景 + L1 入场 + L2 语义对齐 TTS 必做（禁止每镜 CSS infinite ambient）。交付前必须跑 verify-delivery-checklist.py + verify-index-encoding.py + npm run check（0 error）。中文 TTS 默认 Edge TTS（generate-tts.py）；TTS 后必须 align-subtitles.py（faster-whisper 词级时间戳）再 apply-audio-schedule.mjs；不需要 hyperframes-media。Agent 须自动跑完全部环境与构建（预检、脚手架、TTS、对齐、时间轴、校验），用户只需手动 npm run dev 预览；禁止自动 render 导出 MP4，须等用户确认后再导出。口播（voice）与字幕（subtitle）分离：TTS 按口播整句生成，禁止为字幕单行上限拆分 TTS。将用户的口播稿按语义拆分为多个场景，生成上屏文案、规划布局、分配时长、指定转场和动效，并统筹配音/BGM/音效编排。
ztaihang/agent-skills/hyperframes-shorts.descriptionEn: HyperFrames 中文短视频视觉与版式预处理规范（抖音/小红书竖屏可读）。适用于任意镜头数量的中文解说视频。必须先读本 Skill，再读 hyperframes、hyperframes-cli、gsap；写 HTML 前必须读 design-taste-frontend（taste-skill）、templates/anti-slop-motion-scheme.md、templates/hyperframes-zh-checklist.md、css-animations、design-motion-principles、web-typography 与 templates/visual-style-guide.md，每项目须产出 design.md（含 Motion Plan）并轮换视觉风格，禁止套同一模板。硬性版式：底部字幕永远单行、页面文字不得重叠、中文须本地 fonts/ + @font-face（禁 PingFang/微软雅黑/Google Fonts）、禁止 AI 风 emoji/表情包式插图；动效：L0 `#root` 静态背景 + L1 入场 + L2 语义对齐 TTS 必做（禁止每镜 CSS infinite ambient）。交付前必须跑 verify-delivery-checklist.py + verify-index-encoding.py + npm run check（0 error）。中文 TTS 默认 Edge TTS（generate-tts.py）；TTS 后必须 align-subtitles.py（faster-whisper 词级时间戳）再 apply-audio-schedule.mjs；不需要 hyperframes-media。Agent 须自动跑完全部环境与构建（预检、脚手架、TTS、对齐、时间轴、校验），用户只需手动 npm run dev 预览；禁止自动 render 导出 MP4，须等用户确认后再导出。口播（voice）与字幕（subtitle）分离：TTS 按口播整句生成，禁止为字幕单行上限拆分 TTS。将用户的口播稿按语义拆分为多个场景，生成上屏文案、规划布局、分配时长、指定转场和动效，并统筹配音/BGM/音效编排。
ztaihang/agent-skills/hyperframes-shorts.descriptionCn:
HyperFrames中文短视频视觉和布局预处理规范（抖音/小红书竖屏可读）。适用于任意镜头数量的中文解说视频。必须先阅读此技能，然后阅读hyperframes、hyperframes-cli、gsap；在编写 HTML 之前，您必须阅读 design-taste-frontend (taste-skill)、templates/anti-slop-motion-scheme.md、templates/hyperframes-zh-checklist.md、css-animations、design-motion-principles、web-typography 和 templates/visual-style-guide.md。对于每个项目，您必须生成一个 design.md（包括运动计划）并旋转视觉样式；禁止重复使用相同的模板。

硬布局规则：底部字幕必须始终为单行，页面文本不得重叠，中文必须使用本地字体/ + @font-face（禁止使用苹果、微软雅黑、谷歌字体），禁止使用AI风格的表情符号或meme风格的插图；动画：L0`#root`静态背景+L1入口+L2语义对齐。 TTS 是强制性的（禁止每次拍摄 CSS 无限环境光）。

在交付之前，您必须运行 verify-delivery-checklist.py + verify-index-encoding.py + npm run check（零错误）。中文TTS默认为Edge TTS（generate-tts.py）； TTS 之后，您必须运行align-subtitles.py（更快的耳语单词级时间戳），然后运行apply-audio-schedule.mjs；不需要超帧媒体。

Agent必须自动完成整个环境和构建过程（预检查、脚手架、TTS、对齐、时间线、验证）；用户只需要手动运行 npm run dev 即可预览。禁止自动渲染/导出到 MP4 - 导出必须等待用户确认。

语音（voice）和字幕（subtitle）是分开的：TTS是根据所说的句子生成的，并且TTS不得被分割以满足字幕单行限制。将用户的口语脚本在语义上分割为多个场景，生成屏幕副本，规划布局，分配持续时间，指定转场和动画，并协调画外音/背景音乐/音效安排。

zw008/vmware-avi/vmware-avi.descriptionCn: 每当用户提到负载平衡、入口、虚拟服务、池成员、AVI、NSX ALB、AKO 或应用程序交付时，请使用此技能。当用户提到 Tanzu/vSphere 环境中的 AKO 入口故障排除时也会触发。当用户明确要求从头开始设置或配置 nginx/HAProxy/Traefik 时，不要触发 - 这些不是 AVI 任务。直接处理：虚拟服务列表和启用/禁用、池成员管理（排出/启用流量）、SSL 证书过期检查、分析和错误日志、服务引擎运行状况、AKO Pod 故障排除、AKO Helm 配置管理、入口注释验证、K8s 到控制器同步诊断和多集群 AKO 概述。请始终将此技能用于任何“虚拟服务”、“池成员”、“AKO 状态”、“AKO 日志”、“入口诊断”、“ssl 过期”、“负载均衡器”、“NSX ALB”、“AVI 控制器”、“AKO 同步”、“入口”或“负载均衡”任务。对于虚拟机生命周期，请使用 vmware-aiops；对于 NSX 网络，请使用 vmware-nsx；对于 K8s 集群生命周期 (Supervisor/TKC)，请使用 vmware-vks。

zw008/vmware-harden/vmware-harden.description: Use this skill whenever the user needs to perform VMware compliance auditing, baseline checking, or drift detection on vSphere/ESXi/NSX environments. Directly handles: CIS / DISA STIG / vSphere SCG / 等保 2.0 三级 / PCI-DSS scans; custom YAML baselines; LLM-driven remediation suggestions; web dashboard.
